title: Betting Operations Admin VA (Full-Time, AU Client, Tue-Sat)
description:
# Betting Operations Admin VA (Full-Time, AU Client, Tue-Sat)



## About the Role



This is a full-time operations role supporting a solo matched betting and bonus betting operator based in Australia. The business runs a high-volume book across multiple bookmaker accounts, and this hire exists so the operator can step back from the daily operation and focus on growth.



You will take ownership of the repeatable daily work: account creation, deposits, withdrawals, session monitoring, account management, and contact communication. You will be the person keeping the operation running Tuesday to Saturday while the operator focuses on strategy.



This is not a role with a structured manager, a written handover, or documented processes. You will be learning a live operation as it runs. That is not a gap - it is the job. The right person finds that straightforward, not unsettling.



## What You'll Be Responsible For



**Account creation**

This is the highest-volume task in the role. The operator sources new accounts through providers. You create them using details he supplies, complete verification and setup steps, and get each account into the system ready for use. This is ongoing work throughout every week.



**Deposits and withdrawals**

You process deposits and withdrawals across active accounts inside the betting automation software, following standing instructions. Anything outside those instructions - amounts, accounts, or timing that does not match the normal pattern - goes to the operator before you touch it.



**Session monitoring**

You monitor active betting sessions during shifts. A logged-out account or stopped session is yours to handle directly. A restriction, lock, or anything unusual from the platform goes to the operator before you act.



**Contact communication**

The operator communicates with two groups: account providers he approaches on social media, and a small group he does non-promo betting with. You handle both on his behalf during shifts. Anything outside the normal pattern from either group is escalated to him before you respond.



**Running defined betting edges**

Once you are trained and signed off by the operator, you will run certain defined edges through the automation software. Which edges these are will be determined through the training process.



**Start and end-of-shift check-ins**

You check in with the operator at the start of each shift via 
 or
. At the end of each shift, you send a close-of-shift update covering what was done, anything unusual, and any items outstanding. You do not wait to be asked.



## What Makes This Role Different



Liam has never had staff before. There are no runbooks, no documented processes, and no one who has done this job before to hand it over to you. That is genuinely unusual, and it matters.



It means the structure of this role comes from you - your own notes, your own checklists, your own end-of-day habits. The operator is relaxed and easy to work with, and he will not follow up if things go quiet. The VA who works well here is one who finds that a natural way to operate, not a gap to wait out.



It also means the escalation boundary is critical. You are working with real money, live login credentials, and active bookmaker accounts. The boundary between what you handle and what goes to the operator before any action is taken is clear - and respecting it is non-negotiable, especially once you have money authority.



## What You'll Learn



You will come in knowing the general approach and learn AutoMB - the betting automation software - as part of onboarding. The operator is also mid-migration onto the platform, so the first few weeks will involve learning it together as his own setup is finalised.



Over time, you will build a thorough working knowledge of a live matched betting and bonus betting operation: how accounts are created, managed, and monitored; how deposits and withdrawals flow through the system; and how sessions are run across the racing program.



You will also build your own reference documentation for the role from scratch - which is a skill in itself, and one that will serve you in any future operations position.



## Who We're Looking For



**Must-Have - Traits**



You keep yourself organised without being prompted. You have worked in a role before where you had to create your own structure, and you did it - you built the tracker, wrote the checklist, kept the log. You do not wait to be told.



You communicate proactively and in writing. If something is outstanding, you say so. If something is unusual, you flag it before you touch it. If you need something from the operator, you ask. You do not go quiet.



You are precise with other people's money and details. You read instructions carefully, you copy account details accurately, and you do not guess when the stakes are financial. Errors cost money in this operation, and you know that.



You understand escalation. You know the difference between something that is yours to handle and something that needs a decision from someone above your remit - and you escalate before acting, not after.



**Must-Have - Schedule and Availability**



You are available Tuesday to Saturday, every week. Tuesday to Friday: 11:00am to 7:00pm AEST. Saturday: from 8:30am AEST through the main racing program (typically finishing around 2:00pm to 3:00pm AEST, though it varies with the card).



Saturday 8:30am availability is a firm requirement. If you cannot commit to this, this role is not the right fit.



**Must-Have - Confidentiality**



You work inside a closed system handling real funds, identity documents, and active login credentials. Before starting, you sign an NDA and IP agreement. During the role, you do not store IDs or credentials locally, do not share anything from inside the system or the software, and do not discuss operations outside approved channels.



You do not run your own betting or matched betting accounts. This is a direct operational conflict with the operator's accounts and is a firm requirement.



**Nice-to-Have**



- Prior experience in matched betting or bonus betting operations - knowing how bookmaker accounts work, what account health looks like, and how bonus structures operate

- Experience with betting automation software or account management platforms - any background that shortens the learning curve on AutoMB

- A history of building processes from scratch in a previous role - someone who has documented as they went and found it natural

- Prior experience handling identity documents or financial data in a professional setting - exposure to working carefully inside confidentiality constraints



## Schedule



- Tuesday to Friday: 11:00am to 7:00pm AEST

- Saturday: 8:30am AEST start, finishing after the main races (typically around 2:00pm to 3:00pm AEST)



## Compensation and Benefits



- Full-time engagement through FindMyVA

- Stable, ongoing role with one consistent client

- Clear operating scope with defined escalation paths



## Why You'll Enjoy Working Here



The operator is easy to work with. He is relaxed, non-formal, and communicates in short, practical messages - no bureaucracy, no lengthy approval chains, no office politics. It is one person, one operation, and a clear scope.



If you are the kind of person who likes knowing exactly what needs to happen each day, doing it well, and working without someone looking over your shoulder - this role is a good fit. You will have genuine ownership of a real operation from early on, and you will build reference material and a working rhythm that is yours.



---

s

Part of our posting is automated, so you'll also be the human who checks everything is running correctly, handles account security checks and verifications, and fixes anything the automation can't.

, and YouTube account active, secure, and in good standing

- Keep an account tracker with status, followers, and any issues for every account

2. Content Publishing

3. Community Management

- Reply to comments and DMs quickly and in each brand's voice

- Send product and order questions to our Customer Support team

- Hide or report spam, and flag negative feedback or anything urgent

- Spot common customer questions and objections, and share them with the team



4. Trends & Content Ideas

- Watch TikTok and Instagram trends, sounds, and formats in our niches every day

- Send weekly content ideas and hooks to our Creative Strategist / Video Creator

- Study competitor and top-performing accounts and share what's working for them

- Test new formats (carousels, slideshows, talking-head, UGC-style, trends) and report results



5. Community Platforms

- Take part in relevant online communities (like 
 and
 groups) as the brand, openly and honestly, following each community's rules

- Answer questions helpfully and share useful content, not spam

6. Reporting

- Track followers, views, engagement, link clicks, and top posts for every brand in Google Sheets

- Send a weekly report: what grew, what flopped, top 3 posts, and ideas for next week

- Flag accounts that are stuck, restricted, or underperforming



A TYPICAL DAY

- Morning: check all accounts for security prompts, warnings, and failed or wrong posts

- Midday: publish and schedule content, and write captions

- Afternoon: reply to comments and DMs, research trends, and send ideas to the creative team

TOOLS YOU'LL USE

, YouTube, and Reddit

 (team communication)

REQUIREMENTS

NICE TO HAVE

Sales & Dispatch Coordinator – Garage Doors



About Slide & Glide

If you love the phone, can chat easily with anyone, and get a buzz out of closing a sale, keep reading.

Sales (your number one priority)

title: Signage Estimator
description:
We are a Melbourne-based signage company working with premium builders, shopfitters, and commercial clients.

We are looking for a team member with strong experience in construction drawing interpretation, tender documentation, signage estimating, and quantity take-offs.

You should be comfortable working through architectural plans, elevations, reflected ceiling plans, schedules, specifications, details, and other related tender documents.

Key Responsibilities

Construction Drawing & Tender Package Review

• Independently review and navigate complete architectural and construction drawing packages.

• Locate and identify signage requirements across different drawings and documents.

• Read plans, elevations, sections, details, schedules, legends, and specifications.

• Cross-reference information between drawings to determine the complete signage scope.

• Extract signage types, quantities, dimensions, locations, materials, fixing methods, and installation requirements.

• Identify drawing notes and specification requirements that may affect signage pricing.

• Identify missing information, discrepancies, or potential scope gaps.

• Determine when additional information or clarification is required before pricing.

Estimation & Quoting

• Prepare accurate signage quantity take-offs.

• Prepare detailed quote sheets using Microsoft Excel.

• Calculate material quantities, fabrication, finishing, illumination, installation, access equipment, freight, and other relevant costs.

• Research supplier pricing and apply appropriate material and market rates.

• Prepare pricing for tender submissions.

• Review builder/shopfitter scope requirements and ensure all relevant signage items are included.

• Clearly identify inclusions, exclusions, assumptions, and qualifications.

Signage Production Knowledge

A good understanding of signage manufacturing is highly desirable.

The candidate should be familiar with common signage products and materials such as:

• Aluminium and stainless steel

• ACP / aluminium composite panels

• Acrylic

• Vinyl and architectural films

• Fabricated and laser-cut letters

• 3D lettering

• Illuminated signage and LED

• Wayfinding signage

• Braille and tactile signage

• Statutory signage

• Pylon and freestanding signage

• Digital signage

• Various fixing and installation methods

You should understand that the way a sign is designed, fabricated, fixed, transported, and installed directly affects its cost.

Most Important Skills

1. Construction Drawing Interpretation - Essential

You must be able to:

• Navigate large drawing sets independently.

• Find relevant information without being told exactly where to look.

• Understand drawing references and cross-references.

• Read architectural plans and elevations confidently.

• Understand construction details and specifications.

• Extract dimensions and quantities accurately.

• Follow a signage item through multiple drawings and documents.

• Identify information that may affect fabrication and installation costs.

2. Estimating & Analytical Skills

• Strong attention to detail.

• Accurate quantity take-off skills.

• Good numerical and analytical ability.

• Strong Excel skills.

• Ability to compare supplier pricing and determine appropriate allowances.

• Ability to identify potential costs that may not be immediately obvious from the signage schedule.

3. Signage Industry Knowledge

Previous experience in signage estimating, signage production, quantity surveying, construction estimating, or a related field is highly desirable.

Australian signage and construction experience is a significant advantage.

Basic familiarity with viewing or working with artwork files is an advantage but is not a core responsibility of this role.

Standard Pricing & Estimating System

We have an established standard pricing system and pricing references for commonly used signage materials, products, fabrication methods, and installation requirements.

The successful candidate will be trained to understand and use our pricing structure, including:

• Standard material rates

• Standard fabrication allowances

• Common signage product rates

• Installation rates

• LED and illumination allowances

• Finishing and coating allowances

• Freight and packaging allowances

• Access equipment and installation considerations

• Standard labor allowances

• Typical supplier pricing

You will not be expected to know all of our pricing from day one. However, you must be able to understand the logic behind the pricing and apply the correct rates to each project.

The ability to recognize when a project falls outside standard pricing and requires additional supplier research or a specific quotation is also important.

Mentor & Training Program

We provide a structured mentor program for the successful candidate.

During the initial training and trial period, you will work closely with an experienced member of our Melbourne team.

You will initially receive guidance and review of your work. As your understanding and accuracy improve, you will be expected to take greater ownership of projects and eventually manage tender packages independently.

English & Communication

• Good written and spoken English.

• Ability to communicate clearly with the Melbourne team.

• Ability to understand technical instructions, drawings, specifications, and tender documentation.

• Ability to raise clear questions when information is missing or unclear.

Working Hours

Full-time availability is preferred.

We will also consider candidates who can work 5-6 hours of overlap with Melbourne business hours every working day.

Working hours will be based on Melbourne time (AEST/AEDT).

Salary & Terms

• Starting rate: USD $5.00 per hour

• Trial period: 2 weeks to 2 months, depending on experience and performance.

• Trial work will be paid hourly or monthly as agreed.

• Candidates who demonstrate strong performance during the trial may be offered a stable, long-term position, with the opportunity to negotiate an annual salary and permanent team role.

• Ongoing training and mentoring will be provided to suitable candidates.

How to Apply

Please send us:

1. Your resume/CV

2. A brief cover letter describing your experience with construction drawings, estimating, quantity surveying, or signage.

3. Examples of previous estimating or tendering work, if available, such as:

• Signage take-offs

• Tender quote sheets

• Quantity take-offs

• Signage schedules

• Construction drawing mark-ups

• Previous signage estimating projects

4. Confirmation of your available working hours in Melbourne time (AEST/AEDT).

description:

title: Inventory Controller
description:
Inventory Controller

Location: Remote — Philippines | Type: Full-time, remote (engaged as an independent contractor) | Level: Individual Contributor | Reports to: Director, Supply Chain





Schedule: Core overlap with US business hours required.

About Rhino USA

Rhino USA is a family-founded brand that designs and sells premium tie-down straps, recovery gear, and outdoor and automotive accessories. We sell across our own storefronts and major marketplaces, ship from multiple domestic and international warehouses, and run our operations on the Fulfil ERP. As we scale across channels and regions, keeping a single, trustworthy view of inventory is mission-critical — and that is exactly what this role owns.

The Role

We are hiring a detail-obsessed Inventory Controller to be the person who makes our inventory numbers true. You will reconcile stock, movements, and settlement data across every channel and warehouse we operate — Fulfil ERP, Amazon, Walmart, TikTok Shop, and other marketplaces, our 3PL/WMS feeds, and our international warehouses — and turn a tangle of conflicting reports into one clean, defensible source of truth.

This is a hands-on individual-contributor role for someone who genuinely enjoys hunting down a 12-unit discrepancy until they know exactly where it came from. You will not manage a team; you will own the accuracy of the data itself. If you find satisfaction in a reconciliation that ties out to zero, you will fit in well here.

What You'll Do

Multi-channel reconciliation (the core of the job)

Reconcile on-hand, inbound, reserved, and in-transit inventory between Fulfil ERP (our system of record) and every sales channel and warehouse, identifying and resolving every variance.

Own channel-level reconciliation across Amazon (Seller & Vendor Central / FBA & FBM), Walmart, TikTok Shop, and our other marketplaces and storefronts — matching stock ledgers, inbound/receiving records, reserved and unfulfillable quantities, and settlement/financial reports back to Fulfil.

Reconcile 3PL and warehouse (WMS) feeds — receipts, putaways, picks, adjustments, and cycle counts — against ERP records for both domestic and international warehouses, accounting for multi-currency, multi-location, and customs/in-transit nuances.

Investigate root causes of discrepancies (mis-scans, timing/cutoff differences, unmapped SKUs, returns not processed, FX and unit-of-measure mismatches, sync failures) and drive them to resolution rather than just flagging them.

Reconcile Amazon and marketplace reimbursements, lost/damaged inventory, and settlement data, and open/track cases to recover what we're owed.

Data accuracy & controls

Maintain accurate SKU mappings, unit-of-measure conversions, and channel listings so data flows cleanly between systems.

Design and run a recurring cycle-count and audit cadence with warehouse partners, and lead investigation of count-to-system variances.

Post and document inventory adjustments in Fulfil with clear, auditable notes and supporting evidence.

Monitor system syncs and integrations for failures or drift; escalate and follow up until data is aligned again.

Reporting & continuous improvement

Produce clear, recurring reconciliation reports and inventory-accuracy dashboards for Supply Chain and Finance, with variances quantified and explained.

Build and maintain reconciliation workbooks / trackers (advanced spreadsheets, and reporting inside Fulfil) that others can trust and follow.

Document repeatable SOPs for every reconciliation process you own, and continuously tighten them to reduce recurring errors.

Surface trends and systemic problems (channels or warehouses that drift most, common error types) and recommend process or system fixes.

Cross-functional collaboration

Work closely with Operations, Finance, Purchasing, and warehouse/3PL contacts — often across time zones and languages — to resolve issues and close the loop.

Support month-end and periodic inventory close with reconciled, sign-off-ready numbers.

Partner on new channel, warehouse, or region launches to ensure inventory data is set up correctly from day one.

What You Bring

Must-haves

3+ years in inventory control, inventory/reconciliation analysis, inventory accounting, or a closely related operations/finance role — ideally supporting a US-based e-commerce, retail, or distribution business.

Demonstrated experience reconciling data across multiple systems (ERP vs. marketplaces vs. warehouse/WMS), with a track record of finding and resolving discrepancies.

Hands-on experience with at least one major marketplace back end — Amazon Seller/Vendor Central strongly preferred — plus familiarity with how marketplace inventory, reserved stock, inbound, and settlements work.

Advanced spreadsheet skills (Excel / Google Sheets): pivot tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, INDEX-MATCH, SUMIFS, and comfort cleaning and matching large, messy data sets. 

Exceptional attention to detail and numerical accuracy — you notice the row that doesn't tie out, and you can't leave it alone.

Strong investigative and problem-solving instincts: you trace a variance to its root cause instead of writing it off.

title: Amazon Growth Lead / General Manager
description:
ABOUT US

We are an established e-commerce business growing brands on Amazon, with strong in-house capability across operations, advertising, and listing optimisation. We are ready for the next stage of growth and want a senior operator to lead it.

We are looking for a senior Amazon growth expert who can spot the gains we miss from the inside and bring expertise beyond what we have today.



ABOUT THE ROLE

You will take strategic ownership of our Amazon growth — PPC and listing optimisation — and lift performance well beyond where it sits today. This is the core of the role.



This is not campaign maintenance. You will assess how we work, challenge our assumptions, and build a stronger system for profitable growth. As a senior hire, you will also hold general-manager ownership of the wider operation — setting priorities, leading the team, and keeping execution on track — but we are hiring first for your depth in growth.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



Amazon PPC Strategy (core)

– Audit our Amazon advertising and identify the major performance gaps

– Develop portfolio-level PPC strategy across products and ASINs

– Manage Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display, and other relevant formats

– Evaluate performance beyond ACOS — TACOS, organic rank, impression share, contribution margin, conversion rate, customer acquisition, and product lifecycle

– Identify where ad spend is wasted versus driving organic rank, brand defence, customer acquisition, or growth

– Sharpen keyword harvesting, search-term management, campaign segmentation, bid and budget allocation, and placement optimisation

– Set clear objectives for each ASIN based on its strategic role



Listing Optimisation (core)

– Audit listings for keyword relevance, positioning, conversion, differentiation, and customer intent

– Improve titles, bullets, descriptions, search terms, images, and A+ Content

– Use keyword research, competitor analysis, customer reviews, search query data, and conversion data to strengthen listings

– Test listing changes and measure their commercial impact

– Keep listing and PPC strategy working together



Systems & Reporting

– Introduce automation and AI tools where they can improve decision-making, efficiency, and performance

– Build the scorecards and dashboards to run growth on clear numbers

– Translate findings into clear priorities and actions for the owner

– Keep us current on developments in Amazon advertising, AI, analytics, and e-commerce



Operations & Team Leadership

– Own end-to-end operations across inventory, supply chain, team scaling, SOPs, KPIs, and product launches

– Oversee inventory and supply chain — demand forecasting, stock health, supplier coordination, and fulfilment

– Build, scale, and develop the team, and coordinate work across functions

– Step in, take ownership, and drive execution across the business without hand-holding

– Fix the processes, tools, or assumptions that are limiting growth



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

– 5+ years of senior Amazon marketplace experience

– Advanced, hands-on Amazon PPC management for established brands or large portfolios

– Deep strength in listing optimisation, keyword research, conversion improvement, and competitor analysis

– Proven success improving profitability, sales, organic ranking, and ad efficiency

– Experience with multi-ASIN accounts and complex campaign structures

– Strong commercial understanding of revenue, gross and contribution margin, inventory, and return on ad investment

– Strong knowledge of current AI tools and how they can be applied to Amazon operations, PPC, research, and listing optimisation

– Ability to spot problems and opportunities that aren't obvious

– Able to own operations, build systems, and lead a team without hand-holding

– Experience overseeing e-commerce operations end to end, including inventory and supply chain

– Experience managing people and coordinating across functions

– Excellent written and spoken English, and the confidence to explain what to change and why



STRONG ADVANTAGES

Experience with any of the following is a plus:

1. Amazon Marketing Cloud

2. Amazon Marketing Stream

3. Amazon DSP

4. Search Query Performance data

5. Brand Analytics

6. Impression share and organic ranking analysis

7. Data warehouses, dashboards, or customised reporting systems

8. Portfolio-level budget allocation

9. AI-assisted campaign analysis and listing optimisation

10. Managing Amazon brands generating significant annual revenue

11. Agency leadership, account strategy, or consulting experience



WHO WILL SUCCEED IN THIS ROLE

You will do well if you:

1. Think beyond standard PPC metrics and distinguish tactical fixes from strategic opportunities

2. Are comfortable challenging existing approaches professionally

3. Can explain what to change, why, and how to implement it

4. Bring structure and clarity to complex Amazon accounts

5. Keep learning and stay current as the platform and tools change

6. Want to influence business strategy, not just complete assigned tasks



We are not looking for someone who only adjusts bids and downloads reports. We want someone who can teach us something we do not already know.



WORKING DAYS AND HOURS

– Full-time – 40 hrs/week (Mon–Fri)

– Working hours: 10 am to 6:30 pm (30 min lunch break)

– 14 days of Paid Annual Leave and Paid Public Holiday Benefits (all major holidays in the Philippines)



APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS

Please apply with the following. Applications without these will be less considered.

– Your CV/Resume

– A short video introduction of yourself and why you're a good fit

– A summary of the Amazon brands, accounts, or portfolios you have managed

– Two detailed examples of how you improved Amazon PPC or listing performance

– The approximate monthly advertising spend and number of ASINs you have handled

– Why you are leaving your last job, or what you were doing before this application

title: Creative Assistant / Personal Assistant
description:
Creative Assistant / Personal Assistant



Ongoing remote work | Starting at 5 hours per week | Plenty of room to grow



I’m looking for a creative, organised and thoughtful person to work with me on an ongoing basis, starting at around 5 hours per week, with the potential for the role to grow significantly if we work well together.



This is not really a traditional personal assistant role.



I’m a very ideas-driven person. I tend to think through messy brain dumps, interconnected ideas, half-finished thoughts, transcripts and lots of creative rabbit holes. Often I can see the big picture very clearly, but I need help turning everything in my head into organised, usable systems, projects and next steps.



A big part of this role is having someone I can think with.



What the role would look like at the beginning



Initially, I’d be looking for help with things like:



* Taking messy brain dumps, notes and AI transcripts and helping turn them into something clear and usable

* Being someone I can bounce creative ideas off

* Asking good questions and helping me develop ideas further

* Giving me genuine feedback, including telling me when you think something could be simpler or work differently

* Helping me create systems and workflows so ideas actually get implemented

* Organising projects, priorities, information and loose ends

* Keeping track of decisions, where projects are up to and what needs to happen next

* Helping break large or overwhelming projects into manageable pieces

* Taking smaller creative and organisational tasks off my plate

* Researching things when needed and bringing the useful information back in a way that is easy to process



I already have someone working with me on the IT/development side, so I’m not looking for this person to be a developer.



This role would sit more on the creative, organisation, communication and project-support side, although there may naturally be some collaboration between everyone as things grow.



Where the role could grow



I’m building something that I hope will become much bigger over time, so there is a lot of room for the right person to grow into the role.



Eventually, this could include:



* Social media planning and content development

* Helping develop creative campaigns and ideas

* Creating and organising visual resources

* Helping develop workbooks, guides and larger atlas-style books

* Turning rough concepts into polished resources

* Helping with layouts, Canva and visual storytelling

* Researching and developing new projects

* Helping keep different projects visually and creatively consistent

* Becoming much more involved in the overall creative process



Some of the things I want to create in the future are highly visual, interactive and a little outside the usual workbook format, so someone who enjoys making information interesting, human and visually engaging would probably have a lot of fun here.



What it’s like working with me



Communication is probably the most important part of this role.



I value clear, honest communication enormously.



I would much rather someone tell me:



“I’m confused about this.”



“I don’t think this is going to work.”



“I need more information.”



“I think you’ve overcomplicated this.”



“I made a mistake.”



“I’m really good at this part, but this other part isn’t my strength.”



…than quietly struggle or tell me what they think I want to hear.



I genuinely respect people who understand their own strengths and weaknesses.



Having weaknesses does not put me off hiring someone. Everyone has them. Being able to recognise them, communicate them and work around them is much more valuable to me than pretending you’re brilliant at everything.



As a boss, I’m very collaborative.



I like talking ideas through, asking for opinions and figuring things out together. I don’t want somebody who feels like they have to sit silently waiting for instructions.



At the same time, I don’t expect someone to be available 24/7 or magically know what I’m thinking.



I want to build a work culture where people can communicate openly, ask questions, make mistakes, have boundaries and do good work without everything becoming unnecessarily stressful.



I can be extremely enthusiastic when I’m working on something and sometimes generate ideas faster than they can realistically be implemented. Part of being a good fit for me may actually be being comfortable saying:



“Great idea. Not for today. I’m putting that in the later pile.” 😂



I’m looking for someone who can work with my creativity without either shutting it down or getting swept away by every new idea.



You might be a great fit if you:



* Love untangling messy information

* Enjoy creative brainstorming

* Are organised without needing everything to be rigid

* Can see connections between ideas

* Communicate clearly and honestly

* Are comfortable giving constructive opinions

* Are proactive

* Are curious and like learning new things

* Can work independently once something is clear

* Are comfortable using AI tools

* Have reasonably good visual instincts

* Enjoy figuring out better ways of doing things

* Are comfortable working in a growing business where systems are still being developed



Experience with Canva, Notion or other project-management tools, social media, design, publishing, content creation, creative businesses or AI tools would be useful, but you absolutely do not need experience with all of them.



The role will start at approximately 5 hours per week.



I want to start small, get to know how we work together and gradually increase responsibilities rather than throwing someone into everything immediately.



For the right person, there is plenty of room for the role, hours and responsibilities to grow.



A few questions for your application



Please answer the questions below when you apply.



They’re not trick questions and I’m not looking for perfect answers.



Your responses will help me figure out whether our communication styles and ways of working might mesh well, which is much more important to me than receiving a perfectly polished application.



1. Tell me a little about yourself.



What kind of work have you done before, and what kinds of work do you genuinely enjoy?



2. What would you say are your biggest strengths?



They don’t have to be directly related to this role.



3. What are your weaknesses or areas you don’t feel particularly confident in?



Please answer this honestly.



I actually really value people who understand what they are and aren’t good at. I don’t see having weaknesses as a negative.



4. Imagine I send you a huge messy brain dump.



There are half-finished ideas, random notes, things that contradict each other and probably three completely different projects mixed together.



I say:



“There’s something good in here, but my brain is fried. Can you help me figure out what I’m actually trying to do?”



How would you approach it?



5. If I gave you an idea and you genuinely thought I was making it much more complicated than it needed to be, what would you do?



6. What does good communication between you and the person you work for look like?



7. If you didn’t understand something I asked you to do, how would you handle it?



8. Are you someone who prefers very specific instructions, or do you enjoy being given a goal and figuring out how to get there?



Or somewhere in between?



9. Tell me about something creative you’ve made, organised or helped develop that you’re proud of.



This can be professional or personal.



If you have examples of creative work, Canva designs, resources, social media, documents, workbooks, systems or anything similar, I’d love to see them.



10. What tools or software are you already comfortable using?



And are there any tools you’d particularly like to learn?



11. What is your usual availability?



Please include your time zone, general working hours and how many hours per week you would ideally like if the role expanded.



12. What is your hourly rate?



And finally:



13. What about this particular role made you want to apply?



You absolutely do not need to write an essay for every question.



I’m much more interested in getting a feel for how you think, communicate and work than receiving a formal corporate application.



If this sounds like the strange little intersection between creativity, organisation and problem-solving that your brain enjoys, I’d love to hear from you.

title: Remote Lettings and Property Management Assistant
description:
Celestial Globe North London (CGNL) is looking for a Lettings and Property Management Assistant to support our team while working from home. You will help manage enquiries, advertise properties, support tenants through move in and day to day tenancy matters, and keep landlords updated. The role requires clear communication, careful follow up and good knowledge of UK lettings and property management.

Working arrangement  Remote, working UK hours (9:00 am to 6:00 pm).

Key responsibilities

• Prepare and publish accurate property listings on Zoopla and Rightmove, including descriptions, photographs, floor plans and key property details; check listings regularly and update availability, prices and status when instructed.

• Respond promptly to prospective tenant enquiries, arrange viewings with the relevant colleagues, follow up with applicants and help progress offers and tenancy paperwork.

• Coordinate the move in process, including referencing updates, tenancy documents, deposit administration, inventory and check in bookings, keys and clear instructions for new tenants.

• Help tenants after move in with practical questions, including how to register council tax, gas, electricity, water and broadband accounts; liaise with suppliers or the council where needed and follow up until issues are resolved.

• Log maintenance requests, gather the information and photographs needed, obtain quotes or arrange contractors as appropriate, schedule access, track progress and confirm completion with tenants and landlords.

• Keep landlords and tenants informed about repairs, delays, costs and next steps; flag urgent issues promptly to the property manager.

• Arrange check outs, inventories and end of tenancy cleaning; help gather evidence for proposed deposit deductions and communicate the outcome clearly.

• Track tenancy dates and assist with renewals, notices and other routine tenancy administration.

• Help arrange gas safety checks, EPCs, electrical and other required property documents or licensing where applicable, and keep records and reminders up to date.

• Assist with rent and client account administration, including checking payment records, following up on arrears, preparing information for landlord statements and escalating discrepancies.

• Maintain accurate property, landlord, tenant and contractor records; communicate with councils, utility providers, managing agents and freeholders when required; attend regular team meetings and report on open tasks.

What we are looking for

• Previous UK lettings or property management experience is essential, with a practical understanding of tenancy administration and tenant support.

• Confident written and spoken English, with a friendly and professional approach to tenants, landlords, applicants and contractors. Mandarin is an advantage.

• Strong organisation and attention to detail, with the ability to manage several cases, keep clear records and follow tasks through to completion.

• Comfortable using
, spreadsheets, property databases and online listing platforms; experience with Zoopla and Rightmove is useful.

• Able to work independently from home during UK working hours, communicate proactively with the team and recognise when an issue needs to be escalated.

How to apply

Please send your CV and a short cover letter to 
 with the subject line “Remote Lettings and Property Management Assistant – Your Name”. Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted.

CGNL is an equal opportunity employer. Please tell us if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.

title: SEO Content & Website Assistant
description:
We are hiring a part-time, long-term remote assistant to publish and optimise content on our website and keep our local search presence in shape.



Role snapshot



Title: SEO Content & Website Assistant

Engagement: Independent contractor, remote

Hours: 15 to 20 hours per week to start, with scope to grow

Overlap: At least 3 hours per weekday within 9am to 5pm Sydney time

Payment: Monthly

Reports to: Director

About us



Squire is a Sydney building design and project management practice. We take residential and small commercial projects from design and council approvals (DA, CDC and CC) through to construction.



Our clients are homeowners, developers and builders across Sydney. They find us through Google, referrals and our past projects, so our website and Google Business Profile need to be accurate, active and easy to find.



The role



You turn our notes, photos and drafts into published, optimised web content, and you run the recurring tasks that keep us visible in local search. We give you the direction and the technical input; you make it happen reliably, every week.



Content and website



Format, optimise and publish 2 to 4 pieces per month (articles, suburb service pages, project case studies) in WordPress or our site builder

Turn voice memos, rough notes and AI drafts into clean, readable pages for our review

Write meta titles and descriptions, headings, image alt text and internal links

Resize, rename and compress project photos before upload

Keep service, team and contact pages current



Local SEO



Post weekly to our Google Business Profile, add photos and answer Q&A

Draft review replies using our templates, and send review requests to recent clients

Build and maintain directory listings (Houzz, HiPages, Yellow Pages, True Local and similar) with a consistent business name, address and phone

Find and pursue relevant local link opportunities from suppliers, builders and consultants we already work with



Maintenance and reporting



Monthly checks for broken links, missing meta data, slow pages and indexing issues in Google Search Console

A one-page monthly report covering our agreed KPIs

Turn our screen recordings into written step-by-step procedures (SOPs)

Reshare published content to LinkedIn and Instagram



What this role is not



We set the strategy and review everything before it goes live. Please do not apply expecting to run your own SEO playbook.



No paid link packages, private blog networks (PBNs) or link exchanges, ever

No publishing technical planning or building advice without our sign-off

No changes to hosting, domain or site admin settings

No contact with our clients other than approved review requests



Requirements



Must have



Excellent written English, with attention to grammar and tone

2+ years publishing content in WordPress or a similar CMS

Working knowledge of on-page SEO: meta data, headings, alt text, internal linking

Hands-on experience with Google Business Profile and directory listings

Reliable internet, a backup power or connection plan, and your own computer

Organised and consistent: you follow checklists, meet weekly deadlines and flag blockers early



Nice to have



Experience with Australian clients, ideally in building design, construction, trades or property

Google Search Console and GA4 reporting

Basic image editing (Canva, Photoshop or similar)

Comfortable using AI writing tools as a starting point, not a finished product



How we work



Tasks: a shared task board with recurring weekly and monthly tasks already set up

Training: we screen-record each task once (Loom); you turn it into a written SOP

Check-ins: a 15-minute weekly call, plus a short end-of-day update (done, next, blockers)

Access: your own logins with editor rights, shared through a password manager

Tools: WordPress, Google Business Profile, Google Search Console, GA4, Canva, Microsoft 365



How we measure success (reviewed monthly)



Pieces published on schedule

Google Business Profile calls, direction requests and website clicks

Website enquiry form submissions

Rankings for 10 agreed target search terms

New Google reviews



How to apply



Send the following. Applications without them will not be reviewed.



A short cover note (under 200 words) on why this role suits you

Links to 2 or 3 pages you have published or optimised, and what you did on each

Your hourly rate, available hours and the Sydney hours you can overlap

Start your message with the words "Squire Sydney" so we know you read the full brief

Who we are

CB Direct is a U.S. fleet hardware service company. Since 2015 we have installed and serviced GPS trackers, dash cameras and telematics devices in commercial vehicles across the United States. Our field technicians do the install. Our project coordinators make sure the customer's rollout is planned, scheduled, tracked and finished on time.



The role

You will own a customer project from kickoff to close-out. Not assist. Own. You are the person accountable for the schedule holding, the records being right, and the customer never having to ask where things stand.



You will start with one project so you can run it well: discovery and progress calls with the customer, scheduling and confirming appointments with drivers and site contacts, lining up technicians, chasing loose ends, and giving leadership a clear, current picture.



Every hire goes through our scheduler training first and graduates before taking a project. That is how we make sure you know how the work actually gets done before you are responsible for it.



What you will do

-Own the project schedule, records and on-time completion

-Run discovery and recurring progress meetings with customers on video

-Coordinate technicians on availability, scope and timing

-Build multi-site and multi-state deployment plans, and rebuild them when the customer or the field changes

-See delays coming and move the plan before they become problems

-Heavy scheduling in Salesforce; book and confirm appointments by phone

-Work follow-up calls and
s through to resolution

-Keep customer records accurate and current; close the loop on every open item

-Send short, clear status reports leadership can act on





What we are looking for

We hire the top 5% of applicants, not the qualified ones. Strong candidates can point to specific examples of:

Project ownership - you managed, coordinated or led projects from start to finish and owned the outcome

Managing others - you were responsible for other people's work, kept them on track, and dealt with it when someone missed

Sound judgment - you make good decisions without waiting to be told, and you know when to escalate

Attention to detail - dates, names, counts and records are right the first time

Results - your resume shows outcomes and numbers, not a list of duties





Requirements

-Fluent, professional English, clear enough for daily customer calls in the U.S.

-Camera on by default for customer meetings, team check-ins and leadership reviews. This is a requirement, not a -preference. Please do not apply if you prefer camera off.

-Full availability Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM U.S. Central, working exclusively for us

-Able to start training on September 28 or October 5, 2026

-Reliable computer with a second monitor, stable high-speed internet with a backup, headset and webcam

-Able to learn new systems quickly and think critically without constant direction





How to apply

Put "Golden Circle" in the subject line so we know you read the whole post. Applications without it are not reviewed.

In your application, answer these three:

1. A project you owned from start to finish, who you were responsible for, and how it turned out

3. How you use AI tools in your day-to-day work, with one specific example (name the tool)

title: SENIOR LOAN PROCESSOR — Business Funding / MCA (Full Cycle)
description:
Read This Entire Job Post Before Applying

We're a U.S.-based business funding company that places merchants with banks, MCA lenders, SBA partners, equipment financiers, and revenue-based lenders. We close real deals every week. We don't need someone to "learn the industry" — we need someone who already lives in it.

If you've never personally pulled bank statements apart, calculated NSFs and average daily balances, stipped a file, submitted to Kapitus, OnDeck, Credibly, Idea Financial, Fundbox, Forward Financing, Headway, Lendini, or similar — this role is not for you. Please do not apply.



What You'll Actually Do (Daily)



Pre-underwrite every incoming deal: pull MCAs from bank statements, calculate position counts, true revenue, holdback capacity, debt service, NSFs, negative days, and stacking history

Build clean submission packages (app + 3-6 months bank statements + stips) and submit to the right lenders the first time

Negotiate offers — push back on lenders, get factor rates down, extend terms, raise approval amounts, fight for better commission splits

Manage the deal pipeline in our CRM from submission ? approval ? contract ? funding

Communicate directly with merchants for stips, signatures, voided checks, landlord verifications, ownership docs

Handle declines intelligently — reposition the file, find a lender that fits, don't just give up

Run renewals, refis, and stacked positions where appropriate





Required (Non-Negotiable)



Minimum 2 years processing/underwriting MCA, term loans, LOCs, or revenue-based financing for a U.S. broker shop, ISO, or direct lender

Working relationships (or recent submission experience) with at least 8 MCA lenders by name

Can read a 3-month bank statement spread and tell me the true monthly revenue, NSFs, daily balance, and how many positions are stacked — in under 10 minutes

Fluent written and spoken English (we will test this on the call)

Reliable high-speed internet, backup power, a quiet workspace, and a working webcam

Can work U.S. CST hours



Strongly Preferred/ Not Required



Experience with iLending, Mantis, OnyxIQ, ZohoCRM, or similar broker/ISO platforms

Prior experience at a U.S. ISO or funder shop (please name them in your application)

Underwriting credentials, finance/accounting background, or formal training





Do Not Apply If



You've only done "lead gen" or "appointment setting" and want to call yourself a processor

You need someone to walk you through what a factor rate, holdback, or specified percentage is

You ghost, disappear, or go silent for days at a time

You're juggling 3 other clients and this will be your side gig

You've never actually submitted a deal to a real lender portal

You inflate your resume — we verify everything, including calling former employers





Compensation Structure

Base Salary (paid weekly or bi-weekly via Wise):



$640 - $1000 USD / month base hourly rate/ depending on experience, region, and references

30-day paid trial period at the lower end of the band — full base kicks in after passing

Reviewed every 90 days based on performance



Performance Bonuses:



3% per funded deal you fully processed (submission to funding)

+$150 bonus on any deal funded over $100K

+5% of net commission on any deal where you found the lender / negotiated terms that beat the initial offer by 10%+

Monthly volume bonus: $300 if you process 15+ funded deals in a calendar month, $750 if you process 25+



Other:



10 paid days off after 90 days

Paid U.S. holidays after 6 months

Annual performance bonus tied to total funded volume

Long-term: opportunity to grow into a Head of Underwriting / Ops role as we scale



Top performers in this role consistently clear $3,500+ in incentive/commissions only plus the base hourly rate. If that doesn't excite you, you're not the person we're looking for.



How to Apply (Follow Exactly — We Auto-Reject Applications That Don't)



1. Subject line - Pineapple Loan Processor

(Yes, "Pineapple." If you skip this word, your application is deleted unread. This is the first filter.)

2. In the body of the application, Create a voice recording and answer these in order:



How many years have you processed MCA / business loan files for U.S. shops? Which companies?



Name 8 MCA or business lenders you've personally submitted deals to in the last 12 months

What's the highest-deal-volume month you've ever personally processed? (# of funded deals + total $ funded)



A merchant has $45K monthly revenue, 6 NSFs in the last 3 months, 2 open positions totaling $850/day in payments, and a 580 FICO. Which 3 lenders do you submit to first, and why?



What's your expected monthly base salary in USD?



Confirm you can work 8 AM – 5 PM CST consistently



3. Attach:

A 60-90 second unedited video (Loom, Google Drive, or YouTube unlisted) introducing yourself, naming the last 3 companies you processed for, and walking us through the toughest deal you ever got funded.



(If you attach a pdf resume, it will not be looked at and you will not be considered for the position.)



4. Include three professional references with phone numbers and emails — preferably former managers at U.S. shops. We call all of them.



Applications without the code word, without the video, or with vague answers will not be reviewed. We're hiring one person. Make it obvious it should be you.

title: Experience B2B Graphic Designer
description:
>> APPLICATION NOTE: Portfolio submission is REQUIRED. Applications without a portfolio will not be reviewed. Also, applicants with experience working with a SERVICE ORIENTED (vs product) organization will be given priority. 



ABOUT US

We are a leadership development and organizational consulting firm. We partner with executives, team leaders, and organizations to strengthen leadership, grow culture, and deliver measurable results. Our work is professional, polished, and purpose-driven — and our visual brand needs to reflect that at every touchpoint. We are primarily service oriented vs product oriented, and we're looking for someone who understands and has experience designing for a service oriented, and preferably a professional services firm.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We are looking for a graphic designer available on a part-time, on-demand contract basis.  Your primary work will be creating polished, executive-quality graphics for our
 newsletter, LinkedIn presence, and marketing campaigns.



You are the right fit if:

• You have a strong portfolio of professional, corporate, or B2B design work

• You create graphics that look clean, refined, and executive — not casual or template-heavy / AI obvious

• You are reliable, responsive, and communicate proactively

• You take pride in brand consistency and attention to detail



Note: Consistent, ongoing work for the right candidate — this is a long-term relationship, not a one-off gig.



WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY BE DOING

Primary Work (Recurring, Bi-Monthly)

• Design 2 sets of graphics per month for our
 newsletter (typically due Tuesdays for Wednesday sends)

• Create LinkedIn post graphics and supporting visuals for our social media content

• Maintain strict brand consistency across all deliverables



Project-Based Work (As Needed)

• Design assets for marketing campaigns (social media graphics, LinkedIn content, webinar materials, promotional pieces)

• Create lead magnets, downloadables, and presentation templates

• Design client-facing documents and branded materials

• Support brand guideline updates as our visual identity evolves



Bonus (Highly Valued, Not Required)

• WordPress content updates for special initiatives or landing pages

• Video editing to support website 

• LinkedIn page management support — scheduling posts, basic engagement monitoring, content coordination





Note: Web design and WordPress experience is a PLUS but will NOT compensate for weak graphic design skills. Design quality comes first.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

* Portfolio: Must demonstrate professional-quality graphic design work — corporate, B2B, professional services, or consultancy clients preferred. Newsletter graphics, LinkedIn visuals, and campaign assets are especially relevant.

*Experience: 5+ years of professional graphic design experience

* Tools: Proficiency in Canva is required.  Plus if can also use Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign). You should be able to work in both environments.

* LinkedIn Design Knowledge: Understanding of LinkedIn visual formats, dimensions, and what performs well on the platform for professional/thought leadership content

*Communication: Professional written English — clear, proactive, and concise. You flag issues early, confirm deadlines, and don't go silent.

*Availability: Weekly overlap with US Central Time (CST) is required — Manila time (approximately 5:00–7:00 AM PHT or 10pm - midnight+) for check-ins and feedback sessions

*Work Integrity: All work must be done by you personally. No outsourcing or subcontracting.



IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE

You've worked with professional services firms, consultancies, coaches, or B2B brands. You understand corporate and executive aesthetics — you know the difference between "polished and refined" and "Canva template." You can translate concepts like leadership, culture, and organizational growth into visuals that resonate with a business-professional audience. You're self-directed and don't need hand-holding, but you check in at the right moments.



WORK ARRANGEMENT

• Contract position (not employment)

• Part-time, on-demand — flexible hours with recurring baseline work

• Remote work from the Philippines

• Project-based invoicing

• Consistent baseline work each month (newsletter + LinkedIn graphics) with additional project opportunitie. Consistent, ongoing work for the right candidate — this is a long-term relationship, not a one-off gig.



HOW TO APPLY

To be considered, please submit ALL of the following:

1. Portfolio link or PDF — showcasing professional/corporate design work (REQUIRED)

2. 2–3 specific examples of: newsletter graphics, LinkedIn post visuals, or campaign assets you have personally created

3. A brief cover letter (3–5 sentences is fine) — tell us: who you've designed for, what tools you use daily, and your availability in Manila time

4. Confirmation that you can be available for weekly live collaboration with US Central time zone (PHT 5- 7:00am or 10pm – midnight+)



*Applications missing a portfolio or the specific design examples will not be reviewed.



We are an equal opportunity employer. We value quality, integrity, reliability and clear communication above all.

title: Sales Administrator / Sales Operations Coordinator
description:
B2B Procurement & Supply Company | Work From Home | Full-Time



Company: Anything Supplies Pty Ltd

Location: Remote / Work From Home

Work Hours: Full-time

Salary: ₱40,000 – ₱60,000 per month, depending on experience

Start Date:As soon as possible



About Us



Anything Supplies Pty Ltd is a growing B2B procurement and supply company helping businesses source products across different industries. We work with suppliers, customers, sales representatives, logistics and management to move opportunities from lead stage through to RFQ, quotation, order and delivery.



We are looking for a highly organised and confident **Sales Administrator / Sales Operations Coordinator** to support our sales team and help keep our sales process structured, updated and moving forward.



This is not just a basic VA role. This role is for someone who can manage sales administration, CRM updates, RFQ tracking, follow-ups, reporting and coordination with the team.



Role Purpose



Your role will be to support the sales team by keeping the sales pipeline organised, tracking leads and RFQs, following up with sales representatives, updating the CRM, preparing reports, and helping management have clear visibility of sales activities and opportunities.



You will work closely with the Administration Manager, sales team, marketing team and directors.



Key Responsibilities



1. CRM and Pipeline Management



You will help maintain and update the company’s CRM and sales pipeline.



Responsibilities include:



* Updating leads, opportunities and customer records

* Making sure sales stages are accurate

* Tracking lead status, RFQ status and quotation status

* Checking that sales representatives are updating their records properly

* Identifying missing information in the CRM

* Keeping pipeline data clean, accurate and up to date



2. Lead and RFQ Tracking



You will help monitor sales leads and RFQs from start to finish.



Responsibilities include:



* Tracking new leads from different sources

* Recording RFQs received from customers

* Following up with sales reps on RFQ progress

* Checking whether quotes have been sent

* Monitoring pending quotes and customer responses

* Escalating delayed or unattended opportunities

* Helping ensure no lead or RFQ is forgotten



3. Sales Team Follow-Up



You must be comfortable following up with sales representatives and reminding them about pending tasks.



Responsibilities include:



* Checking daily sales activity

* Following up on overdue tasks

* Reminding team members to update CRM

* Tracking customer follow-ups

* Supporting sales reps with admin requirements

* Helping management understand what each sales rep is working on



4. Reporting



You will prepare daily and weekly sales administration reports.



Reports may include:



* New leads received

* RFQs received

* Quotes sent

* Pending quotes

* Follow-ups due

* Deals won or lost

* Sales rep activity

* CRM update status

* Bottlenecks or delays

* Priority opportunities

* Issues requiring management attention



5. Coordination With Internal Teams



You will coordinate with different departments to support the sales process.



This may include:



* Sales team

* Admin team

* Marketing team

* Logistics team

* Sourcing/procurement support

* Management/directors



Your role is to help information move properly between the team so tasks are completed on time.



6. Sales Administration Support



You may also assist with:



* Preparing simple sales documents

* Organising customer information

* Updating spreadsheets

* Preparing meeting notes

* Creating follow-up lists

* Checking quotation status

* Assisting with customer or supplier information

* Supporting management with sales-related admin tasks



Tools You May Use



Experience with any of the following is an advantage:



* GoHighLevel

* Apollo

* HubSpot

* Salesforce

* 

* ClickUp

* Slack

* Google Sheets

* Microsoft Excel

* Google Workspace

* CRM systems

* Lead generation tools



You do not need to know every tool, but you must be confident learning systems quickly.



Requirements



We are looking for someone who is:



* Highly organised

* Confident with follow-ups

* Good with CRM and spreadsheets

* Strong in written English

* Reliable and detail-oriented

* Comfortable working remotely

* Able to communicate clearly with the team

* Able to work with deadlines

* Able to follow processes

* Able to identify missing information

* Not afraid to remind sales reps about pending tasks

* Able to prepare clear reports for management



Ideal Candidate



The ideal candidate has experience in one or more of the following:



* Sales administration

* Sales operations

* CRM management

* Lead tracking

* RFQ tracking

* Sales coordination

* B2B sales support

* Executive admin support for a sales team

* Reporting and spreadsheet management



Important



This role requires someone who can take ownership. We do not want someone who only waits for instructions. We need someone who can check the sales pipeline, identify what is missing, follow up with the right person and report clearly to management.



How to Apply



Please send the following:



1. Your updated resume

2. A short introduction about your sales admin or sales operations experience

3. Tools or CRMs you have used before

4. Your expected monthly salary

5. Your internet speed and computer setup

6. Your earliest available start date



Application Questions



Please answer these questions when applying:



1. What CRM systems or sales tools have you used before?

2. Have you handled sales pipeline updates or lead tracking before?

3. How would you follow up with a sales rep who has not updated their CRM tasks?

4. What daily report would you send to management in this role?

5. Have you worked with RFQs, quotations or B2B sales admin before?

6. Are you comfortable working full-time from home?

7. What is your expected monthly salary?



Subject Line



Please use this subject line when applying:



**SALES ADMIN – ANYTHING SUPPLIES**

title: Creative Content Assistant for Psychedelic Integration Coaching Brand
description:
Part-time | Approximately 8–10 hours/week | $200 USD/month



Hi! I'm Amy, the founder of Karen's Daughter Coaching 
 a small coaching practice focused on personal transformation, psychedelic integration, intentional living, and helping people take meaningful experiences and integrate them into their everyday lives.



I'm looking for a creative, curious person who can help me take the ideas I already have and turn them into valuable content.



This is not primarily an administrative VA role, and I'm not looking for someone to simply plug generic content into Canva.



I have LOTS of ideas. I write, teach workshops, create guides, record videos, coach clients, and am constantly thinking about transformation, integration, Burning Man, psychedelics, creativity, personal growth, and what it means to build a life that feels aligned.



What I need is someone who can listen to a video or voice note, read something I've written, or look through existing material and say:



"There are 5 pieces of content hiding in here."



What you'll help me do



You'll work with raw material I provide, including videos, voice notes, written ideas, workshops, guides, blog posts, and existing content.



From that material, you'll help:



Identify interesting ideas, themes, quotes, stories, and teaching points



Turn those ideas into drafts for Instagram posts and carousels



Develop short-form video/Reel ideas and hooks



Identify ideas that could become
s or longer-form content



Repurpose existing content instead of constantly creating from scratch



Organize ideas into a simple content calendar/library



Learn my voice so the content increasingly sounds like me, not generic marketing copy



I'm not expecting everything you create to be publication-ready. I expect to remain involved in editing and adding my voice.



What I want is someone who helps me get from idea → draft much faster.



About the subject matter



My work includes psychedelic integration, ketamine integration, microdosing mushrooms, personal transformation, somatic practices, creativity, harm reduction, and Burning Man culture.



You do NOT need previous professional experience in psychedelics.



Curiosity matters more to me.



You should be comfortable learning about psychedelics without sensationalizing them or treating them like a trendy wellness product. This work requires nuance, responsibility, and respect for people's experiences.



I'll provide resources and help you learn the landscape.



You might be a great fit if...



You're naturally curious and enjoy learning about psychology, personal growth, creativity, wellness, consciousness, or human behavior.



You're a strong English-language writer and can understand the difference between someone's authentic voice and generic social-media language.



You can listen to someone talk for 10 minutes and recognize the interesting ideas buried inside the conversation.



You don't need detailed instructions for every single task. Once you understand what I'm trying to accomplish, you can bring ideas back to me.



You're also comfortable receiving feedback. Part of this role will be learning my voice together.



What I'm NOT looking for



I'm not looking for someone who produces generic AI content.



I use AI myself, as evidence by this job description. 



I want to remove AI as much as I can from this work.



I'm looking for the human layer: curiosity, creativity, organization, and the ability to recognize when something is actually interesting.



AI can be part of your workflow, but I want my voice to sound human.



Hours & compensation



This is a small role to start:

Approximately 8–10 hours/week

$200 USD/month



I'd like to start with a trial period and grow the relationship if we're a strong fit.



I'm much more interested in finding the right person than someone with the perfect résumé.



How to apply



Please don't send me a generic cover letter.



Answer these questions. Don't overthink these questions. Just a few short sentences. 



1. Why does this particular role interest you?



2. Have you worked with personal-development, wellness, psychology, coaching, psychedelic, or similar content before? It's completely okay if the answer is no.



3. Share 2–3 examples of content you've written or created that best show me how you think.



I strongly encourage you to read my website to get an idea of who I am. If who I am and what I'm working on sounds interesting, I encourage you to apply. And if you look at my website and social media and say "I can definitely do better than that" for sure apply.

title: Operations, Sourcing & Logistics Assistant
description:

About MNJ Trading



MNJ Trading is an import and export company serving customers throughout the South Pacific region. Our customers operate primarily in the hospitality, industrial, and commercial sectors.



We help customers source suitable products, identify competitive suppliers, prepare quotations, coordinate orders, and arrange delivery to their destination.



About the Role



We are looking for a practical, organized, and detail-oriented Operations, Sourcing & Logistics Assistant.



This is not a role based only on writing
s or speaking confidently. You will be expected to research products, compare suppliers, check specifications, calculate shipping volumes, prepare accurate quotations, follow up on orders, and keep information properly organized.



Our selection process includes a practical work assessment based on the actual responsibilities of the role.

- Find and compare suitable suppliers.

- Verify product specifications, pricing, availability, MOQ, lead time, warranty, and delivery conditions.

- Request missing information from suppliers.

- Prepare supplier comparison sheets.

- Calculate carton quantities, weights, dimensions, CBM, and estimated shipping costs.

- Prepare accurate customer quotations.

- Coordinate orders with suppliers, warehouses, freight forwarders, and customers.

- Monitor order and shipment progress.

- Maintain organized records, spreadsheets, invoices, packing lists, and shipping documents.

- Identify missing or conflicting information before it becomes a problem.

- Provide clear updates to management and customers.

- Understands the difference between the lowest price and the best commercial option.

- Communicates delays and problems early.

- Follows instructions and meets deadlines.

- Takes ownership of tasks through completion.

- Asks specific questions when information is missing.

- Produces accurate work without requiring constant supervision.



Required Skills

- Strong online product and supplier research skills.

- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets.

- Ability to compare prices and commercial terms.

- Confidence working with quantities, dimensions, weights, and CBM.

- Strong attention to detail.

Application Process

title: Accounts Receivable & Collections Specialist – Australian Businesses
description:
# Accounts Receivable & Collections Specialist – Australian Businesses



**Full-Time | Remote – Philippines | PHP 60,000–75,000 per month + Performance Bonus Opportunity**



### Join a growing Australian trade services group



We are looking for an experienced Accounts Receivable & Collections Specialist to join our team and take ownership of customer collections across three established Australian businesses:



* Plumbing Bros West Coast – Perth

* Electrical Bros West Coast – Perth

* Plumbing Bros Melbourne – Melbourne



Our businesses provide essential plumbing and electrical services to residential customers, property managers and commercial clients.



We are looking for someone who understands that effective accounts receivable management is about more than sending payment reminders.



You must be able to investigate outstanding invoices, understand customer concerns, communicate professionally and confidently secure payment while maintaining positive business relationships.



You will manage an accounts receivable portfolio of approximately AUD $750,000 across the three businesses.



This is a dedicated AR and collections position, not a general administrative VA role.



### What you will be responsible for



**1. Accounts receivable and collections**



* Proactively contact customers regarding outstanding invoices by telephone,
 and SMS.

* Manage aged debt across 30, 60 and 90+ day categories.

* Prioritise accounts based on outstanding value, age, payment history and escalation status.

* Follow up payment commitments and ensure agreed dates are monitored.

* Maintain accurate records of all collection activities.

* Follow our established escalation procedures for overdue accounts.



**2. Invoice and dispute investigation**



* Review job histories, work orders, invoices and customer communications in Ascora.

* Understand the work performed by our plumbing and electrical teams.

* Investigate invoice discrepancies and customer payment concerns.

* Review available job notes, photos, quotations and approval records.

* Liaise with operations and tradespeople to obtain missing information.

* Identify genuine disputes and recommend appropriate resolutions.

* Escalate matters requiring management approval.



**3. Payment allocation and reconciliation**



* Monitor incoming customer payments.

* Allocate payments correctly against outstanding invoices.

* Reconcile customer accounts using Ascora and Xero.

* Investigate unidentified payments and account discrepancies.

* Maintain accurate financial and customer records.

* Ensure all payment arrangements are approved in accordance with company procedures.



**4. Reporting and accountability**



* Prepare regular accounts receivable and aged debt reports.

* Track outstanding balances and collection progress across all three businesses.

* Maintain clear notes and next actions for outstanding accounts.

* Identify high-risk accounts and recommend escalation.

* Provide management with visibility of collection activity, disputes and payment commitments.

* Suggest improvements to our collections processes.



### What we are looking for



**Essential requirements**



* Minimum 3 years of accounts receivable experience working with Australian businesses.

* Demonstrated experience actively collecting outstanding customer payments.

* Excellent conversational English and professional written English.

* Confident communicating with Australian customers by telephone.

* Strong understanding of Australian business communication and customer expectations.

* Experience investigating disputed invoices and resolving payment issues.

* Experience with Xero or comparable accounting software.

* Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills.

* Excellent attention to detail and financial accuracy.

* Ability to manage multiple customer accounts independently.

* Strong organisational skills and consistent follow-through.

* Ability to remain professional during difficult customer conversations.

* Reliable internet connection, suitable personal computer and quiet home office.



**Highly regarded**



* Experience working with Australian plumbing, electrical, construction, property management or trade services businesses.

* Previous experience with Ascora, Simpro, ServiceM8 or comparable job management systems.

* Experience reconciling payments across multiple business entities.

* Experience handling complex AR portfolios and commercial accounts.

* Previous experience with debt recovery and formal collection escalation processes.



Ascora training will be provided to the successful applicant.



### The type of person who will succeed



We are looking for someone who:



* Takes ownership rather than waiting to be told what to do.

* Is confident making collection calls and following through.

* Can show empathy without avoiding difficult conversations.

* Understands that maintaining customer relationships is just as important as receiving payment.

* Investigates problems before making assumptions.

* Can distinguish a genuine invoice dispute from a delayed payment.

* Keeps accurate records and never leaves outstanding matters without a next action.

* Demonstrates integrity, accountability and strong judgement.

* Communicates clearly and keeps management informed.

* Is motivated by achieving measurable results.



Our company values are Teamwork, Accountability, Integrity, Communication and Continuous Improvement.



We expect these values to be demonstrated in everyday interactions with our customers and team.



### Systems you will use



* Ascora

* Xero

* Microsoft Outlook / Microsoft 365

* Microsoft Excel / Google Sheets

* Avaya

* Go High Level



Software access and system training will be provided.



### Working arrangements



* Full-time, 40 hours per week.

* Monday to Friday.

* Based in the Philippines, working Australian business hours.
