title: Virtual Assistant For Blog
description:
Hi future teammate!



I run a website and am looking for a website management VA I can trust and who eventually I can form a long-term working relationship with. I am based in Singapore, so we are in the same time zone.



Primary tasks will include:

- Research and compile all the credit card and various finance apps

- Able to write and present information in a clear concise and helpful flow for readers. These include key benefits, features, eligibility & fees and current promotions etc.

- Analyse similar websites and create relevant content

- Analyse website and social media statistics and make recommendations on how to improve follower count, engagement rate etc.

- Tracking / recording / data entry tasks for KPI management

- Other administrative tasks and SOPs, as they come up

- all tools, training and support will be provided!



There are three phases to this job:

Set Up:

In this stage, you will be in charge of proposing and creating a good format and flow of content for the website. In addition, you will be doing a lot of research (I will give suggested websites), where you can read and condense the information and write it in your own words. You will continue to update the promotions as they come. You will work a lot on Wordpress and Canva.

Maintenance:

In this second stage, you will do less of the initial research. By this time, you should have a very good fundamental knowledge of all the finance products in Singapore. You will research and find new finance topics to write about and make proposals and recommendations of how we can do better. You will continue to update the promotions as they come. 

Proposal:

At the third stage, you know the brand and product at the back of your finger tips. If we both don’t know how to do it, it is fine, you will be given the space and time to research and figure out what we can try and what works.



Who should apply:

- Someone with high attention to detail and able to execute data research and workflow well

- Someone who can write well

- Comfortable some level of uncertainty (as the agency develops, systems and SOPs may change along the way)

- Great attitude: coachable, able to adapt, can learn well and learn quickly, speaks their mind, not afraid to provide ideas and solutions to improve and innovate and tell me when i'm wrong (I very much welcome it!)

- Some experience in financial products is a plus, but by no means necessary



If you're interested, please assist me with the following:

- Let me know the best
 address to contact you from to ask you a few more questions

- Send me your resume along with 2-3 samples of what you consider some of your best work.

- include in your reply message the answer to these questions: 

- Contain in your reply message, at the very bottom, the following exact code (case sensitive): G5gfude



What happens when you reply:

- If you did not reply any questions in the google doc, please do not expect a response.

- I'm looking for staff who knows how to write well without AI. Everyone is using AI to reply, therefore, you will only stand out if you legitimately can write well without AI.

- I'll review your response and arrange a zoom interview.



Thank you!

I really look forward to meeting and connecting with you.

description:

-time Creative Strategist to help expand our paid creative system as we scale through Q4 and beyond.

What should be iterated

title: Part-Time Management Accountant / QuickBooks Advisor
description:
We are looking for an experienced Management Accountant / QuickBooks Online Advisor to assist our hospitality and property business for approximately 5–10 hours per week.



We already have a bookkeeper handling much of the day-to-day accounting work.



This role is the next level above bookkeeping.



We are looking for someone who can review what is already in QuickBooks, clean up problems, assist with VAT reporting, provide accounting guidance, and help us better understand the performance of the business.



We operate a resort and hospitality business in Vanuatu, with several related entities covering accommodation, restaurant operations and property-owner accounting.



What we need help with



The initial work will mainly involve reviewing and cleaning up our existing QuickBooks Online accounts.



This may include:



Reviewing historical transactions and identifying errors



Cleaning up duplicated or incorrectly posted transactions



Reviewing the chart of accounts



Checking how transactions are being classified



Reviewing bank and balance-sheet reconciliations



Helping correct historical accounting issues



Reviewing work completed by our existing bookkeeper



Assisting with month-end and year-end adjustments



Helping with VAT returns and VAT reconciliations



Checking that VAT has been treated correctly



Reviewing inter-company and related-party transactions



Helping establish better accounting procedures and controls



We previously experimented with automatically transferring sales information into QuickBooks, which resulted in some duplicated and incorrectly classified transactions. One of the first projects will be helping us clean this up properly.



Management accounting and business insights



We are also looking for someone who can go beyond simply processing transactions.



We would like help understanding questions such as:



How is the business actually performing?



Are margins improving or declining?



Are expenses moving outside normal levels?



Which areas of the business are performing well?



Are there unusual transactions that should be investigated?



How does the current month compare with previous months and previous years?



Is cash flow improving or deteriorating?



Are there accounting issues that management should be aware of?



You do not need to prepare complicated reports every week.



We are looking for someone who can look at the accounts and occasionally say:



“I noticed this — you should probably have a closer look at it.”



That type of insight would be very valuable to us.



VAT experience



Experience with VAT, GST or similar consumption taxes is important.



Our businesses are based in Vanuatu, so you do not necessarily need previous Vanuatu VAT experience.



However, you should have a strong understanding of:



Output VAT / VAT collected



Input VAT / VAT credits



VAT reconciliations



Reviewing VAT returns



Correct treatment of purchases and sales



Identifying transactions where VAT may have been treated incorrectly



We can explain any specific Vanuatu rules where necessary.



QuickBooks Online



You should be highly experienced with QuickBooks Online.



We are not looking for someone who needs to learn QuickBooks after being hired.



Ideally you will have:



4+ years accounting experience



Strong QuickBooks Online experience



Experience cleaning up existing QuickBooks files



Strong reconciliation skills



Experience preparing or reviewing VAT/GST returns



Good understanding of management accounts



Ability to review a Profit & Loss and Balance Sheet and identify unusual items



Good Excel or Google Sheets skills



Strong written English



Good judgement and attention to detail



CPA, CA or equivalent accounting qualifications would be an advantage, but practical experience is more important to us than qualifications alone.



Experience with hospitality, hotels, restaurants, property management or multi-entity businesses would also be useful.



AI and automation



We are interested in gradually using AI to improve efficiency.



Over time, we would like to investigate using tools such as:



ChatGPT



Claude



QuickBooks reporting



Excel / Google Sheets



Zapier



Make



Other accounting automation tools



This could eventually help with things such as:



Management reporting



Owner reporting



Reviewing transactions



Identifying unusual entries



Comparing monthly results



Extracting information from accounting data



Reducing repetitive administrative work



You do not need to be an AI expert.



We are mainly looking for someone who is curious, practical and willing to help us gradually improve the system.



How we like to work



We prefer people who investigate problems before immediately asking questions.



If you encounter an accounting issue, ideally you would come back to us with something like:



“I have looked into this. This is what I think happened, these are the transactions involved, and this is how I recommend we correct it.”



We are happy to answer questions where necessary, but we are looking for someone capable of working independently and applying good accounting judgement.



Hours



Initially approximately:



5–10 hours per week



Hours are flexible.



This would suit an experienced accountant who already has another role or other clients but has some spare capacity each week.



There may be additional hours available from time to time.



Pay



Please advise your expected hourly rate in USD.



We are looking for good value, but we are not simply looking for the cheapest applicant.



We would rather pay more for someone who genuinely understands accounting and QuickBooks and can work efficiently without requiring constant supervision.



How to apply



Please begin your application with:



MANGOES ACCOUNTANT



Then answer the following questions:



What accounting qualification do you have, if any?



How many years of accounting experience do you have?



How many years have you personally used QuickBooks Online?



Have you previously cleaned up an existing QuickBooks file? Please briefly explain what was wrong and how you corrected it.



What experience do you have preparing or reviewing VAT or GST returns?



Are you comfortable reviewing a Profit & Loss and Balance Sheet and identifying unusual or incorrect items?



Have you worked with multiple companies or related entities?



Have you worked in hospitality, property management, restaurants or hotels?



What experience do you have with Excel or Google Sheets?



Have you used ChatGPT, Claude or other AI tools for accounting or analysis?



What is your expected hourly rate in USD?



How many hours per week are you available?



Are you currently employed or working with other clients?



Please do not send a generic application simply saying that you are an expert.



We are looking for someone with genuine practical accounting experience who can demonstrate how they think and solve accounting problems.



For the right person, this could develop into a long-term role supporting management and our existing bookkeeping team.

Who we’re looking for

Australian experience

title: Remote Home Health Clinical Operations & QA Specialist (USRN)
description:
We are seeking an experienced, detail-oriented Remote Filipino USRN to provide high-level clinical, administrative, and operational quality assurance support for our U.S.-based home health organization. In this role, you will manage our end-to-end back-office clinical workflows and chart movement within the WellSky/Kinnser EHR platform—from patient intake and Face-to-Face (F2F) verification to CMS-485 Plan of Care auditing, interim order creation, and clinician follow-ups.

This is a part-time, remote position (20 hours per week) ideal for a highly organized, independent nurse who understands the strict compliance deadlines of Medicare-certified agencies and can seamlessly handle the administrative chart flow so our local clinical leadership and field teams can focus on direct patient care.

Key Responsibilities

Quality Assurance & Chart Review Flow

WellSky Workflow Management: Audit daily skilled nursing and therapy progress notes within the WellSky workflow bucket for clinical accuracy, completeness, consistency, and compliance.

OASIS & CMS-485 Auditing: Review field clinician assessments to build, draft, and finalize comprehensive CMS-485 Plans of Care. Ensure documentation deficiencies or discrepancies are flagged early to support billing, survey readiness, and timely reimbursement.

Clinician Coordination & Chasing: Track documentation deficiencies and proactively follow up with field clinicians via phone, text, or
 to chase missing progress notes, get clarifications, and correct rejected charts.

Orders & Compliance Management

Interim Order Creation: Independently identify, draft, and manage necessary interim or supplemental physician orders within WellSky (e.g., changes in visit frequency, new medications, specialized wound care supplies).

Physician Tracking: Route generated CMS-485s and interim orders to primary care physicians for signatures via electronic methods (e-fax, DocuSign), and aggressively track them to ensure compliance deadlines are never missed.

Status Updates & Discharges: Execute immediate EHR status updates and operational checklists when a patient is admitted, transferred to an inpatient facility, discharged, or passes away.

Intake & Authorizations Support

Referral & F2F Verification: Support the intake pipeline by reviewing incoming hospital discharge records and identifying if the Face-to-Face (F2F) encounter notes legally satisfy Medicare eligibility criteria.

Prior Authorizations: Assist with insurance authorization workflows, including organizing clinical data, submitting requests to managed care portals, and tracking pending approvals.

Required Qualifications & Skills

Active Licensing: Active status as a Registered Nurse (RN) with a valid USRN license (passed NCLEX-RN) and an active PHRN license.

EHR Software Expertise: Hands-on, proficient experience navigating the WellSky / Kinnser home health platform is highly preferred.

Home Health Experience: Minimum of 1–2 years of experience handling U.S. home health quality assurance (QA), chart auditing, utilization review, or clinical documentation support.

Regulatory Compliance: Solid understanding of CMS guidelines, OASIS documentation, F2F criteria, and medical necessity rules.

Communication: Exceptional written and spoken English communication skills, with a confident professional presence when communicating with internal stakeholders and US physician offices.

Technical Setup: Dedicated, private remote workspace with a high-speed primary internet connection and a reliable backup internet option. High commitment to data security and strict compliance with HIPAA privacy standards.

Target Salary Rate: $7.00 – $8.00 / hour (or locally positioned at ₱37,000 – ₱42,000 per month pro-rated for part-time)

title: AI Automation & Integration Engineer | Long-Term Remote Career
description:
AI Automation & Integration Engineer

Long-Term Remote Career | Australian Company | Starting at AUD $3,000 per Month

Full-time | Philippines-based | Australian business hours | Three-month probationary period



Build the systems behind our growth—and build your future with us.

Are you an experienced automation and integration professional who wants more than another short-term project?



Do you enjoy solving real business problems, connecting systems and building tools that people actually use?



Ready Movers is looking for a talented AI Automation & Integration Engineer to join our team for the long term.



We’re a fun, motivated and fast-growing Australian removals company, opening multiple branches each year. As our business expands, we’re investing in the technology, automation and internal systems that will support our next stage of growth.



We need someone who can turn ideas into working solutions, take ownership and help us build a smarter, more connected business.

This is not a “build it, hand it over and your job is done” position.

New branches mean new requirements. Growing teams mean new opportunities to improve. There will be ongoing integrations, new applications, further development and systems that need to evolve with us.



We’re looking for someone who wants to be part of that journey.



What you’ll build

Working directly with management and teams across the company, you will help shape how Ready Movers uses automation, AI and custom business applications.



Your responsibilities will include:

- Business-wide integrations: Connect our CRM, operational systems, communications, accounting and reporting platforms using n8n, APIs and webhooks.

- Custom CRM and internal applications: Develop and improve dashboards, databases, workflows and features that support our sales, operations, customer service and management teams.

- Practical AI solutions: Build AI assistants, agents and integrations that reduce administration, improve communication and make information easier to access.

- Better business processes: Work with our people to identify repetitive tasks, eliminate duplicate data entry and recommend useful improvements.

- Long-term system ownership: Test, document, monitor, maintain and improve what you build. Getting something live is the beginning—not the finish line.



Who we’re looking for

You’re a proven builder—not just someone who knows how to use ChatGPT or list the latest AI tools.



You have hands-on experience delivering automation, integrations and business applications in real working environments. You can show us what you personally built, explain how it works and demonstrate the difference it made.



Your technical experience should include n8n or comparable automation platforms, APIs, webhooks, databases and authentication, with practical coding ability in JavaScript/TypeScript and/or Python.



You should also have experience developing or extending CRMs and internal applications, and implementing AI through APIs and business workflows. You understand that reliable systems need appropriate permissions, secure data handling, error recovery and documentation.



You don’t need to know every product we use. You do need strong technical foundations, sound judgement and the ability to learn quickly.



This is an experienced technical position—not an entry-level role or a general administrative VA position.



How you work matters

You take ownership and follow through. You communicate clearly, ask good questions and can explain technical ideas to people without a technical background.



You don’t need someone to map out every step. You can sit with a team, understand their challenges, recommend an approach and deliver a solution.



You also know when to keep things simple. We’re not interested in adding AI to everything for the sake of it—we want improvements that genuinely help our people and our customers.

Above all, you’re looking to become a valued part of a team, not simply finish the next contract.



Why build your career with Ready Movers?

A genuine long-term opportunity.

We’re building an ongoing capability within our company. As Ready Movers grows, the work will continue to develop through new integrations, new systems and continuous improvement.



An Australian company with Australian working hours.

Work remotely from the Philippines while becoming part of a fun, motivated team supporting an expanding Australian business.



Ownership and visible impact.

Work directly with decision-makers, contribute your ideas and see your solutions being used across multiple branches and departments.



Future earning and career potential.

The starting salary is AUD $3,000 per month, with opportunities for future salary increases and greater responsibility based on your performance, capability and contribution to the business. We want the right person to grow with us—professionally and financially.



A three-month probationary period.

This is an opportunity for both sides to establish a strong working relationship. It is the beginning of an intended ongoing position, not a three-month project.



How to apply — video introduction required

Show us the person behind the CV.

To apply,
 your CV and a video introduction directly to Ernest at 
 your video, cover these three points:

1. Why you’re the best fit for Ready Movers. What makes you stand out, and why does a long-term position with our team appeal to you?

2. How you will help us grow. Explain how your AI, automation, integration and development skills could support an expanding, multi-branch business.

3. Your previous experience. Walk us through relevant projects you personally delivered, the problems you solved and the results you achieved.



Include relevant portfolio links or project examples, your availability to start and confirmation that you can work Australian business hours. You may attach your video or provide a working viewing link. Please do not share confidential information from previous employers or clients.



 subject: AI Automation & Integration Engineer Application — [Your Name]



All applications must be
ed directly to 
 through this post, platform application buttons, comments or direct messages will not be accepted. Applications without a video introduction will not be considered.



Ready to build more than workflows?

Build a long-term career with Ready Movers. Show us what you can do.

title: International Construction Sourcing & Procurement Specialist
description:
Technical Sourcing & Construction Specification Analysis



Ability to review and interpret architectural, civil, structural, mechanical, electrical, and plumbing drawings; construction specifications; Bills of Quantities (BOQ); Bills of Materials (BOM); scopes of work; material submittals; and project requirements. Evaluate supplier and manufacturer quotations to ensure proposed materials and products meet project specifications, applicable standards, and performance requirements while allowing accurate apple-to-apple commercial comparison.



International Material Sourcing & Supplier Identification



Ability to identify, evaluate, and develop qualified domestic and international suppliers and manufacturers for construction materials, building products, equipment, and selected finishes. Conduct global market research to identify cost-effective sourcing opportunities from the United States and international markets while considering material quality, technical compliance, production capacity, shipping requirements, tariffs and duties, customs clearance, lead times, and overall supply-chain risk.



Potential sourcing categories may include structural steel and miscellaneous metals, reinforcing steel, precast products, doors and windows, architectural finishes, flooring, cabinetry, plumbing fixtures, electrical products, lighting, HVAC-related materials, site-development materials, drainage products, geosynthetics, landscaping materials, and other construction-related products where international procurement can provide measurable cost advantages.



Value Engineering & Material Cost Optimization



Ability to review specified materials and construction requirements and identify fit-for-purpose alternatives that reduce project cost without compromising structural integrity, safety, durability, quality, code compliance, aesthetics, or required performance. Work with project management, estimating, design teams, engineers, architects, subcontractors, and owners to evaluate alternative manufacturers, equivalent products, material substitutions, standardized specifications, and other value-engineering opportunities.



Construction Material Compliance & Product Qualification



Ability to verify that proposed domestic and imported construction materials comply with project specifications, approved plans, applicable building codes, and relevant industry standards such as ASTM, ANSI, ACI, AISC, UL, NFPA, and other standards required by the project. Coordinate technical data sheets, certificates, laboratory test reports, samples, shop drawings, product certifications, warranties, and other documentation required for material approval and construction submittals.



Supplier & Manufacturer Capability Assessment



Ability to assess supplier and manufacturer capabilities, including production facilities, equipment, technical competency, capacity, quality-control procedures, certifications, testing capabilities, manufacturing lead times, export experience, packaging methods, and ability to consistently meet project schedules and quality requirements. Conduct or coordinate supplier prequalification, factory evaluations, third-party inspections, and quality verification when appropriate.



Strategic Sourcing & Construction Procurement



Working knowledge of the complete sourcing and procurement process, including material takeoffs and procurement planning, market scanning, supplier identification, RFQ/RFP preparation, bid solicitation, supplier qualification, quotation analysis, negotiation, purchase recommendations, purchase orders, manufacturing monitoring, delivery coordination, supplier development, and supplier performance management.



Develop sourcing strategies that balance domestic purchasing with international procurement based on project requirements, cost savings, schedule considerations, material availability, quality, and supply-chain risk.



Technical-Commercial Bid Evaluation



Ability to perform comprehensive apple-to-apple comparisons of supplier and manufacturer proposals by considering technical compliance, unit pricing, quantities, freight, packaging, insurance, tariffs, customs duties, taxes, payment terms, Incoterms, production lead time, shipping duration, minimum order quantities, warranties, inspection requirements, replacement risks, and supplier reliability.



Evaluate suppliers based on Total Landed Cost and Total Cost of Ownership, rather than material purchase price alone, to determine whether domestic or international sourcing provides the greatest overall value to the company and project.



International Logistics & Landed-Cost Analysis



Ability to coordinate and evaluate international procurement requirements including Incoterms, freight forwarding, container utilization, consolidation, port handling, customs documentation, import duties, tariffs, brokerage, inland transportation, cargo insurance, warehousing, and delivery to project sites in Nashville, Tennessee and other company project locations.



Prepare landed-cost analyses comparing international sourcing against domestic suppliers to determine actual project savings after all transportation, importation, handling, storage, quality-control, and schedule-related costs are considered.



Negotiation & Commercial Acumen



Ability to develop and execute supplier negotiation strategies using cost analysis, supplier competition, historical pricing, international market intelligence, commodity trends, volume leverage, project pipelines, payment terms, alternative materials, manufacturing efficiencies, freight consolidation, and long-term supplier relationships.



Capable of negotiating pricing, minimum order quantities, production schedules, freight responsibilities, warranties, payment structures, quality requirements, replacement provisions, and other commercial terms with both U.S.-based and international suppliers.



Construction Spend & Global Market Intelligence



Ability to analyze company and project procurement spend, material consumption, supplier concentration, commodity pricing, construction-material trends, freight conditions, currency considerations, tariffs, industry benchmarks, and alternative manufacturing markets.



Identify categories where global sourcing, supplier consolidation, bulk purchasing, project bundling, framework agreements, or direct-from-manufacturer purchasing may generate meaningful savings across multiple building and land-development projects.



Contract, Purchase Order & Commercial Terms Management



Working knowledge of supplier purchase agreements, purchase orders, payment terms, deposits, letters of credit or other international payment arrangements, warranties, liabilities, insurance requirements, delivery obligations, inspection requirements, quality provisions, confidentiality agreements, Incoterms, cancellation provisions, delay responsibilities, and other commercial terms relevant to domestic and international construction procurement.

title: We're Hiring: Full-Time Video Editor!
description:
About Us

Alien Prints is a fast-growing custom apparel company based in Addison, Illinois. We produce 200+ orders per month of screen-printed, embroidered, and DTF-transferred custom apparel for construction companies, service businesses, and organizations across the US.



We're searching for a creative and detail-oriented Full-Time Video Editor who can turn ideas into engaging visual content. From social media clips to marketing campaigns, you'll play a key role in creating videos that captivate audiences and elevate our brand.



Job Requirements: Must have

• 2+ years of experience editing short-form video content (TikTok, Reels, Shorts)

• Portfolio/reel showing at least 10 short-form videos you’ve edited

• Proficient in CapCut Pro, Adobe Premiere Pro, or DaVinci Resolve

• Strong understanding of hooks, pacing, captions, and trending formats

• Ability to turn around 8–10 short clips per day consistently

• Understanding of what makes content perform on each platform (TikTok vs Reels vs Shorts)

• Clean, professional editing style — not over-edited, not under-edited



Nice to have

• Experience editing content for product-based or service-based businesses

• YouTube long-form editing experience (chapters, b-roll, pacing)

• Motion graphics or animation skills (After Effects, Motion)

• Thumbnail design skills (Photoshop or Canva)

• Basic color correction and audio cleanup skills

• Familiarity with royalty-free music libraries and sound design



Job Overview

The role

You are the person who takes raw footage and turns it into scroll-stopping content. Every day, you will receive raw video clips from our shop floor (printing presses running, orders being made, finished products) and talking-head recordings from the owner. Your job is to edit these into short-form and long-form videos optimized for each platform.



This is a high-volume role. You will produce 8–15 edited video pieces per day across different formats. Speed, consistency, and understanding of what makes content perform on social media are essential.



What you will do

Short-form video editing (primary focus — 70% of time)

• Edit raw clips into 15–60 second videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts

• Add captions/subtitles to all videos (burned-in, styled, readable)

• Write and add text hooks in the first 1–2 seconds of every video

• Add transitions, zoom effects, and pacing that match platform trends

• Select and sync trending audio/music where appropriate

• Create satisfying loop videos from production process footage (press pulls, ink shots, transfer peels)

• Edit before/after reveal videos with dramatic transitions

• Format and resize the same video for different platforms (9:16, 1:1, 16:9)



Long-form video editing (20% of time)

• Edit 1 long-form YouTube video per week (5–15 minutes)

• Full process walkthroughs: a single order from design to shipping

• Educational content: print method comparisons, branding guides, industry tips

• Add intro/outro, lower thirds, chapter markers, and b-roll where needed

• Create compelling thumbnails for YouTube videos



Ad creative (10% of time)

• Edit short video ads for Meta 
/Instagram) campaigns

• Create multiple variations of the same ad for A/B testing

• Follow direct creative briefs from the Content Manager



Daily output expectations

• 8–10 short-form videos (TikTok/Reels/Shorts format) per day

• 2–3 Stories-format clips per day

• 1 long-form YouTube video per week

• 1–2 ad creatives per week

III. Final Interview

title: Digital Marketing and Content Specialist
description:
Hotel Tano is seeking an energetic, creative, and data-driven Digital Marketing & Content Specialist to lead our digital presence and drive guest engagement. 



In this role, you will be responsible for creating compelling digital content, managing social media channels, running targeted ad campaigns, performing routine website maintenance, and protecting our brand reputation. Your primary focus will be telling the Hotel Tano story to local guests and international travelers, boosting direct bookings, and showcasing our unique amenities from our on-site dining and lobby lounge to our leisure offerings.



Key Responsibilities

Website Content & Basic Updates: Perform basic website edits and maintenance via WordPress (or CMS), including updating room rates, promotional banners, seasonal packages, dining menus, photo galleries, and event announcements. Ensure website copy and contact details remain accurate and up to date.



Content Creation & Storytelling: Design, shoot, and edit photo and video assets (Reels, TikToks, Stories, feed posts) showcasing room accommodations, dining experiences, amenities, and local Tumon attractions.



Social Media Management: Plan, schedule, and execute social media content calendars across platforms (Instagram,
, TikTok, Line, KakaoTalk, LinkedIn). Engage with user comments, messages, and tagged content promptly.



Digital Advertising & SEO: Execute paid ad campaigns on Google, Meta, and OTAs. Optimize hotel website copy, landing pages, and metadata to boost search engine visibility and drive direct booking conversions.



Brand Reputation Management: Monitor and respond to online guest reviews across platforms such as Google, TripAdvisor, 
, and Agoda in alignment with Hotel Tano’s brand voice.



 Marketing & Campaigns: Build and send targeted promotional newsletters for special events, seasonal room packages, dining specials, and loyalty promotions.



Analytics & Reporting: Track key performance indicators (website traffic, conversion rates, engagement rates, ROI on paid spend) and present monthly actionable insights to management.



Cross-Departmental Collaboration: Partner with Front Desk, F&B, and Events teams to capture real-time hotel activations, menu updates, and special guest experiences.

title: Appointment Setter B2B — $1,200 US per month + $50 per show-up
description:
Please just send us any message if you're interested, and we will send you a Google Form. All applications will be considered through the form.

Why strong setters join us

We built a role where your results are directly reflected in what you earn — with a guaranteed base, clear performance bonuses, and a team that genuinely invests in your growth. If you're experienced, consistent, and take your craft seriously, this is a place where you can build something real.

01 — Uncapped earning potential



Your compensation grows with your performance. The structure is transparent, the targets are achievable, and there's no ceiling on what you can earn each month.

02 — Experienced leadership that develops you



You'll work closely with a team that knows this business inside and out. We share what's working, coach on what isn't, and help you sharpen your skills continuously — tone, objection handling, and conversation flow.

03 — A supportive, high-performing team



We hold a high standard here, and we support each other in reaching it. You'll be working alongside people who are serious about their work and their growth.



Compensation — paid every week via Wise

Base salary: $1,200 USD/month — guaranteed



Per qualified appointment (showed up): $50 USD — every one, on top of the base



Working hours



9:00 AM – 5:30 PM Eastern Time (ET)



That is 10:00 PM – 6:30 AM Philippine Time (PHT).

This is a night shift role. We are fully transparent about that. There is a strong and experienced community of Filipino professionals who work US hours — if that's you, and you're comfortable with it, the compensation reflects the commitment.



Onboarding



Your first 10 days are structured onboarding. We walk you through everything — the script, the CRM, and the process — until you feel fully confident.

To join the core team, the target during onboarding is a minimum of 3 qualified appointments. This is a realistic and achievable bar, and we'll be coaching you throughout to help you get there.



What you'll actually do



Make 150–200 outbound cold calls per day to businesses that may need commercial janitorial services.

Identify genuine needs and book qualified appointments for businesses ready to receive a cleaning quote.

Deliver a proven script naturally and conversationally — not mechanically.

Keep your pipeline and call logs updated accurately in our CRM each day.

Receive ongoing coaching and access to the strategies that have proven to work.





Who we're looking for



2+ years in B2B sales or outbound cold calling.

A natural, professional phone presence — you sound like a consultant, not a caller.

Ability to internalize a script and deliver it as a real conversation.

Stable setup: 80+ Mbps internet, a reliable computer, and a quality headset.

Comfortable navigating a CRM independently — logging calls, updating records, and managing your pipeline.





What you're walking into



A company with a clear system, transparent compensation, and leadership that takes your development seriously. You'll know exactly what's expected, exactly what you'll earn, and exactly how to grow. We want people who stay, improve, and build with us long term.

Ready to apply?



If this sounds like the right fit, we'd love to hear from you. Please apply with any message and we will send you a Google form to fill out.

title: Inventory & Accounts Coordinator (Cin7 Core / QBO)
description:
About the Role



We are a CPG food & beverage brand looking for a detail-oriented and highly organised Inventory & Accounts Coordinator to support the business across Cin7 Core, inventory management, purchasing, invoicing, bookkeeping, and monthly financial reconciliation.



This role sits between operations and finance — ensuring that product, inventory, customer, supplier, and accounting records remain accurate and up to date across both Cin7 Core and QuickBooks Online. The ideal candidate is highly comfortable with numbers, systems, and recurring financial processes, with the ability to work independently and spot discrepancies before they become larger issues.



Work Structure & Requirements



Schedule: Part-time

Location: Remote

Timezone: EST business hours

Compensation: 8 USD per hour



Key Responsibilities



Inventory & Cin7 Core Management

Maintain accurate product, supplier, and customer data in Cin7 Core

Manage inventory levels and maintain accurate stock visibility

Input finished product builds / recipes to support MRP and inventory planning

Map ingredient item numbers to supplier item numbers and finished goods to customer item numbers

Input and maintain customer and supplier records

Monitor inventory transactions and investigate discrepancies

Help reconcile Cin7 Core inventory records against supporting operational data

Purchasing, Invoicing & Revenue

Create and send purchase orders through Cin7 Core

Maintain accurate PO records and supporting documentation

Invoice direct customers and distributors

Manage customer-specific pricing and ensure invoices reflect agreed terms

Track revenue across Amazon, DTC, distributors, and direct customers

Reconcile sales activity across channels

Support distributor deductions and customer account adjustments as required

Bookkeeping & Accounts Support

Maintain accurate bookkeeping records in QuickBooks Online

Support accounts receivable and accounts payable administration

Record and categorise expenses accurately

Reconcile bank, credit card, and other balance sheet accounts

Match invoices, payments, and expenses to supporting documentation

Track outstanding customer balances and supplier payments

Assist with monthly expense reconciliation and month-end close preparation

Review QBO monthly and investigate discrepancies or uncategorised transactions

Maintain organised records for invoices, receipts, bills, POs, and other finance documentation

Coordinate with external bookkeepers, accountants, or finance partners where required

Reporting & Reconciliation

Reconcile Cin7 Core activity against QBO

Maintain clear revenue, inventory, and expense records

Identify differences between operational and accounting systems and resolve where possible

Support monthly reporting with accurate data pulls and reconciliations

Flag unusual transactions, missing documents, or inconsistencies promptly



Required Skills & Experience



⚠️ Cin7 Core: Hands-on experience with Cin7 Core is mandatory — candidates without this will not be considered

QuickBooks Online: Strong working experience with QBO across AR, AP, invoicing, expense reconciliation, and month-end processes

Inventory & Operations: Experience working with purchase orders, inventory records, customer pricing, supplier data, SKUs, BOMs/recipes, item mapping, and inventory transactions

Finance Administration: 2+ years in inventory administration, bookkeeping, finance administration, operations, or a similar role

Excel / Google Sheets: Strong skills required for data management and reconciliation work

Accuracy & Organisation: Excellent numerical accuracy, attention to detail, and consistency with recurring finance and operational tasks

Communication: Strong written and spoken English; comfortable working independently across both operational and accounting systems

Industry Background: Experience within CPG, food & beverage, e-commerce, or another physical product business preferred



To Apply:

Kindly send your resume and introduction video

Must have Sales calling experience, natural conversational English, noise-canceling headset, quiet room, stable internet with backup.



Closed deals commission varies but minimum 100 dollars per deal. Can go up to 1,000 plus depending on deal! We close about 3 a month so adding you to the team you'll make a lot more fast!

title: Recruiter
description:
AGENDA INSIDER — RECRUITER IN THE PHILIPPINES



Agenda Insider is a U.S. software and construction-intelligence

company. We monitor city planning and zoning meetings across

American counties and alert construction-related businesses to

development projects — often months before construction begins.



Our customers are excavation contractors, builders, title

companies and lenders. Our initial markets are Utah, Nevada and

Arizona.



We are building a small team of part-time outbound callers in the

Philippines. Before hiring the callers, we are hiring one

excellent recruiter to find them.



This is a recruiting role. You will not be making sales calls

yourself.



───────────────────────────────

WHAT THE CALLERS ACTUALLY DO



This is a factual, low-pressure business conversation — not a

hard-sell campaign and not a scam call.



The caller introduces three real construction or development

projects recently discussed in the prospect's own area. Depending

on the project, that includes the location, acreage, proposed use,

number of homes or units, and the date it appeared before a

planning commission.



Then one simple question:



    "Had you already heard about that project?"



And then:



    "We track dozens — even hundreds — of projects like these as

     they begin emerging in your area. Would you be open to a

     fifteen-minute demonstration so you can see what we're

     finding?"



That is the whole purpose of the call: create interest and

schedule a demonstration.



The research, project information, script and training are all

provided. Callers follow the approved message while sounding

natural. They must never invent facts, make unsupported claims,

pressure a prospect, or imply they represent a city or government

agency.



───────────────────────────────

THE SCHEDULE — SCREEN FOR THIS BEFORE ANYTHING ELSE



The calling window is 8:30 AM to 12:30 PM U.S. Mountain Time.

Four hours, Monday through Friday.



In the Philippines that is a late-evening or overnight shift, and

the corresponding Philippines hours shift when U.S.

daylight-saving time changes.



Every candidate must understand and genuinely accept this before

you present them. More outbound hires fail on schedule than on

skill, and a caller who quits in week two costs us far more than

one we never hired.



───────────────────────────────

WHO WE NEED YOU TO FIND



  • Excellent spoken English — clear, natural, and easy for an

    American business owner to follow over the telephone. This is

    the first filter and nearly everything else is negotiable.

  • Listens and responds conversationally rather than reading.

  • Confident with owners and managers of construction companies,

    many of whom answer their own phones.

  • Calm, steady and curious. Not aggressive, not pushy.

  • Dependable attendance, and willing to take coaching from

    recorded-call feedback.

  • Reliable internet, suitable equipment, quiet place to work.



Previous call-center, appointment-setting or outbound sales

experience helps but is not required. Attitude, reliability,

listening ability and spoken English matter more than an

impressive BPO résumé.



───────────────────────────────

YOUR ASSIGNMENT



Find, evaluate and help us hire two outstanding part-time callers.



We are not hiring someone to collect résumés. Your assignment is

complete when two hires have finished our training and are still

performing well after 30 days — not when you deliver a shortlist.



You will:



  • Source candidates through OnlineJobs.ph,
 groups,

    referrals, your existing network, and anywhere else you have

    real reach.

  • Screen spoken English yourself, in a live conversation. Not

    from a résumé, not from a written application.

  • Evaluate voice clarity, listening ability, confidence, warmth,

    judgment and professionalism.

  • Run a short role-play using a script we provide, and judge

    whether they sound human reading it.

  • Confirm schedule acceptance, internet, equipment and

    workspace.

  • Present five genuinely strong finalists with candid written

    notes — including what is weak about each one.

  • Coordinate and sit in on our final interviews.

  • Help us replace anyone who proves unreliable or does not

    complete training.



───────────────────────────────

COMPENSATION



  • An hourly rate for your approved recruiting work.

  • A success bonus for each caller we hire who completes training

    and is still working well after 30 days.



I would rather pay more for people who perform and stay than pay

less for a large pile of résumés.



Please propose the hourly rate and retention-bonus structure you

believe is fair. Terms are discussed with shortlisted applicants.



This begins as a focused project for two calling seats. If the

campaign succeeds we expect to hire more as Agenda Insider expands

into additional U.S. markets, and the right recruiter becomes a

continuing partner.



───────────────────────────────

HOW TO APPLY



Read this section carefully. Applications that skip any step will

not receive a response.



1. Begin your application with the word DIRT.



2. Provide a link to a voice recording of no more than 60 seconds

   answering:



   "Tell me about a person you recruited who did not work out.

    What did you miss during the hiring process?"



   Vocaroo, Loom, Google Drive, Dropbox or any accessible service.

   Please confirm the link works before you send it. You will be

   judging other people's spoken English, so we need to hear

   yours.



3. In two or three sentences, in your own words:



   "How would you test whether someone's spoken English is strong

    enough to speak with an American construction-company owner on

    the telephone?"



   There is no single correct answer. I want to understand how you

   evaluate people.



4. Tell me two things: where and how you would look for these

   callers beyond waiting for applications to this posting, and

   the most similar recruiting assignment you have completed —

   including what happened to the people you hired.



Do not send a generic cover letter. I will personally read every

application that follows these instructions, and none that does

not.

title: Experienced Real Estate Cold Caller - $4/Hr + Bonuses
description:
We are a US-based real estate investment company looking for a reliable cold caller to join our team long-term.



**Schedule:** Monday-Friday  

**Hours:** 12:00 PM-5:00 PM Eastern Time  

**25 hours per week**  

**Pay:** $4/hour + performance bonuses



### What You'll Do



You'll primarily call homeowners whose properties were previously listed for sale but did not sell.



We provide the leads, Mojo Dialer, script, and training.



Your job is to:



- Make outbound calls using Mojo Dialer

- Follow our provided calling script

- Determine whether homeowners are still interested in selling

- Have natural conversations and ask basic qualifying questions

- Handle basic objections

- Identify interested homeowners

- Take clear and accurate notes

- Pass qualified opportunities to our acquisitions team

- Properly update leads and notes in GoHighLevel (GHL)



You are NOT responsible for negotiating contracts, making offers, or closing deals.



### What We're Looking For



- Strong conversational English

- Clear and confident phone presence

- Comfortable making outbound calls for several hours per day

- Reliable and consistent

- Coachable and willing to receive feedback on recorded calls

- Good listener who can have a conversation without sounding robotic

- Reliable computer, headset, and internet connection

- Available consistently Monday-Friday from 12 PM-5 PM Eastern



Previous experience cold calling US homeowners for real estate investors, wholesalers, or real estate agents is strongly preferred.



Experience with **Mojo Dialer and GoHighLevel (GHL)** is preferred but not required. Training will be provided.



### How to Apply



Please include:

1. A short description of your previous real estate cold-calling experience.

2. What types of real estate lists you have called - expired listings, absentee owners, pre-foreclosures, FSBOs, etc.

3. Have you used Mojo Dialer before? If yes, for how long?

4. Have you used GoHighLevel (GHL) before? If yes, what did you use it for?

5. Approximately how many hours did you previously dial per day?

6. Approximately how many leads or appointments did you typically generate per day or week?

7. What did your previous company consider a qualified lead?

8. A 60-90 second voice recording introducing yourself and describing your cold-calling experience.

9. Confirmation that you can consistently work Monday-Friday from 12 PM-5 PM Eastern Time.



At the very bottom of your application, write: EXPIRED LISTINGS



Applications without a voice recording will not be considered.

title: Full-Time Full-Stack Developer | Next.js, Supabase & WordPress Integrations
description:
Southwind Marketing is a U.S.-based marketing and technology agency looking for an experienced full-stack developer in the Philippines to help build and maintain our branded client and staff platform.



This is a full-time, long-term opportunity. You will help deliver the initial release, build new modules in phases, maintain integrations, and improve the platform as our agency and client base grow.



We are not looking for someone to simply complete tickets. We need a developer who can understand the platform architecture, investigate technical limitations, recommend practical solutions, and take ownership of implementation.



About the Platform



Our clients currently work through account managers for website updates, support requests, project coordination, approvals, files, reporting, and communication.



We are bringing those activities into one secure client portal where clients can:



Request support and website changes

Track projects and tasks

Communicate with staff

Share files

Review reports

Approve work

Edit approved website content

Receive notifications and updates



The platform must also support marketing, consulting, and other clients who may not have a website hosted with Southwind.



Our preferred stack is:



Next.js

React

TypeScript

PostgreSQL

Supabase



An unfinished repository already exists. One of your first responsibilities will be reviewing the existing codebase and determining what should be reused, improved, or rebuilt.



Initial Development Priorities



The first release will include:



 login, invitations, and password recovery

Branded client dashboards

Agency administrator, staff, contractor, and client roles

Clients, projects, tasks, deadlines, assignments, and discussions

Support requests and ticket workflows

Private internal notes

Contractor access limited to assigned work

Client onboarding and offboarding workflows

Checklists and asset collection

Private file storage

Manually uploaded reports

Approval workflows

Version-specific approvals

Comments and requested changes

Approval reminders and decision history

In-app notifications

 notifications

Audit history

WordPress Integration



Our client websites primarily use:



WordPress

Elementor Pro

Advanced Custom Fields

Cloudways hosting



Clients should eventually be able to edit approved website content through the portal without accessing the full WordPress administration area.



This includes approved:



Text

Images

Links

Custom fields

Existing page and post content



Layouts, templates, global styles, and other protected design elements must remain restricted.



You will review representative staging websites, document supported Elementor widgets, templates, and ACF fields, and develop the connector/API functionality required.



The initial release will focus on editing existing pages and posts. More advanced content creation can be added later.



Security & Permissions



Security is a major part of this role.



You should be comfortable implementing:



PostgreSQL Row Level Security

Server-side authorization

Agency → client → project → assignment access boundaries

Private file permissions

Role-based access controls

Privileged-user MFA

Audit logging

Access revocation

Secure file URLs

Authorization checks for background jobs and notifications

Automated tests proving users cannot access another client’s information



Permissions must be enforced at the database and server level, not only in the user interface.



Future Development



After the initial release, planned phases may include:



Social media content planning

Client approvals for social content

Scheduling and publishing workflows

Reporting

GoHighLevel integration

CRM and onboarding workflows

Reusable project templates

Recurring tasks and work

Advanced intake forms

Workflow automation

Expanded website editing

Website and domain management records

Google sign-in

 sign-in

Google Drive connections

Future reseller branding

Multi-agency support



These features will be developed in stages.



Third-party API capabilities must be verified before implementation. Existing CRM, phone routing, automations, and client systems must not be disrupted.



Responsibilities



You will be responsible for:



Reviewing the existing repository

Technical architecture and implementation

Front-end and back-end development

Database design

API integrations

WordPress connector development

Testing

Deployment

Security

Documentation

Bug fixes

Ongoing platform improvements

Regular Git commits

Staging demonstrations

Backup and recovery procedures



Code and infrastructure will remain within accounts controlled by Southwind Marketing.



Documentation should be detailed enough that another qualified developer could understand and continue the project.



Required Experience



We are looking for someone with:



Proven experience building production web applications, SaaS products, or client portals

Strong Next.js experience

Strong React experience

Strong TypeScript experience

Strong PostgreSQL experience

Strong Supabase experience

Experience implementing Supabase Row Level Security

WordPress development experience

PHP experience

WordPress REST API experience

Custom WordPress plugin development

Elementor experience

ACF experience

API and webhook integration experience

Experience building role-based permissions

Experience with approval workflows

Experience with private file storage

Git and repository management experience

Strong debugging and problem-solving skills

Communication



You must have:



Strong written English

Clear spoken English

Reliable communication

Ability to explain technical issues in plain language

Ability to communicate blockers early

Ability to manage milestones independently

Some working-hours overlap with U.S. Central Time

Schedule



This is a full-time position.



The initial goal is to deliver a working first release within approximately 90 days. The final schedule will be agreed after you review the repository, technical scope, and acceptance requirements.



This is not a 90-day contract. Development will continue after the initial release as we add additional modules, integrations, and improvements.



To Apply



Please provide:



Two or three relevant web applications, SaaS platforms, or client portals you have worked on

A clear explanation of your personal contribution to each project

Your experience with Next.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, and Supabase

Your experience implementing Supabase Row Level Security

Your WordPress, Elementor, ACF, and custom plugin experience

Your experience integrating WordPress with external applications

Your experience building approval workflows or granular permission systems

A brief explanation of how you would approach reviewing an unfinished codebase before continuing development

Your current availability

Your earliest possible start date

Your expected monthly compensation in USD

Whether you will personally perform all development work or whether any other developers would be involved



Please include examples that demonstrate actual application functionality, permissions, integrations, or dashboards. Website design examples alone are not sufficient for this position.



Begin your application with:



SOUTHWIND FULL STACK



so we know you read the entire posting.



For the OnlineJobs.ph fields, I’d use Full Time and probably list the three skills as Full-Stack Development, React/Next.js, and WordPress Development if those are available.



$11/hour to start, with room to increase based on experience and performance.
